aws_account_expected_organization_master.description: Compares the observed AWS Organizations MasterAccountId with a separately approved expected management account ID; no expected ID is inferred from the observation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_account_expected_organization_master.
evaluated: Complete organizations:DescribeOrganization Organization.MasterAccountId retained as a validated 12-digit observed ID, plus a separately owner-configured validated 12-digit expected management account ID.
aws_account_expected_organization_master.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS when both validated IDs match; FAIL when validated observed and expected IDs differ or a complete response establishes that the account is outside Organizations; UNKNOWN when policy expectation, Organization details, or read completeness is missing.
aws_account_expected_organization_master.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS when both validated IDs match; FAIL when validated observed and expected IDs differ or a complete response establishes that the account is outside Organizations; UNKNOWN when policy expectation, Organization details, or read completeness is missing.

aws_account_non_eu_resource_region_detec.description: Detects an AWS data resource deployed outside the approved EU Region list; a resource outside approved EU Regions can violate data-residency commitments. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_account_non_eu_resource_region_detected.
evaluated: ec2:DescribeRegions (Regions[].RegionName, OptInStatus), s3:ListAllMyBuckets/GetBucketLocation (Buckets[].Name, LocationConstraint), regional rds:DescribeDBInstances (DBInstanceArn), ec2:DescribeVolumes (VolumeId), dynamodb:ListTables (TableNames), efs:DescribeFileSystems (FileSystemId), redshift:DescribeClusters (ClusterIdentifier), backup:ListRecoveryPointsByBackupVault (RecoveryPoints[].RecoveryPointArn); explicit scan input approved_region_names
aws_account_non_eu_resource_region_detec.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each listed resource, pass iff its region is in approved_region_names; fail for any resource outside that set; UNKNOWN if approved_region_names or inventory for an enabled region or listed service is incomplete. This is a location signal only; customer-data classification remains manual.
aws_account_non_eu_resource_region_detec.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each listed resource, pass iff its region is in approved_region_names; fail for any resource outside that set; UNKNOWN if approved_region_names or inventory for an enabled region or listed service is incomplete. This is a location signal only; customer-data classification remains manual.

aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.description: For an in-use ACM certificate, compares issuance and expiration against the snapshot clock and checks renewal eligibility inside the 30-day window. The result describes certificate metadata and does not prove the renewed certificate is already deployed.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.fail_when: An in-use certificate is not ISSUED, expired, or within 30 days of expiry and INELIGIBLE for renewal.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.not_applicable_when: The complete ACM certificate metadata has an empty InUseBy list.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.pass_when: An in-use certificate is ISSUED, unexpired, and has more than 30 days remaining or is renewal eligible within 30 days.

aws_api_customer_log_delivery.description: Detects an API Gateway stage whose API stage lacks the required access or execution log destination; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_api_customer_log_delivery.
aws_api_customer_log_delivery.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope REST API stage has effective loggingLevel=INFO or ERROR and a nonempty accessLogSettings.destinationArn and format containing requestId, requestTime and status; FAIL otherwise.
aws_api_customer_log_delivery.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope REST API stage has effective loggingLevel=INFO or ERROR and a nonempty accessLogSettings.destinationArn and format containing requestId, requestTime and status; FAIL otherwise.

aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.description: Detects an Auto Scaling launch configuration whose launch user data contains static AWS access key material; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_key.
evaluated: extend existing autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations collector to inspect UserData in memory and project boolean UserDataIndicators.HasAwsKeyPair; raw UserData remains redacted
aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when decoded UserData contains an AWS access key ID (AKIA or ASIA plus 16 capitals/digits) paired with a nearby nonempty aws_secret_access_key assignment; PASS otherwise; UNKNOWN when UserData cannot be decoded or read; never persist the raw value.
aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when decoded UserData contains an AWS access key ID (AKIA or ASIA plus 16 capitals/digits) paired with a nearby nonempty aws_secret_access_key assignment; PASS otherwise; UNKNOWN when UserData cannot be decoded or read; never persist the raw value.

aws_backup_copy_encrypted.description: Detects an AWS Backup vault whose copied recovery point uses an unencrypted destination vault; unencrypted remote copies can disclose backup data if a vault is accessed. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_copy_encrypted.
aws_backup_copy_encrypted.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated remote copy vault has EncryptionKeyArn pointing to a KMS key with KeyState=Enabled and each recovery point created by a copy job has IsEncrypted=true; UNKNOWN without designated remote vaults.
aws_backup_copy_encrypted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated remote copy vault has EncryptionKeyArn pointing to a KMS key with KeyState=Enabled and each recovery point created by a copy job has IsEncrypted=true; UNKNOWN without designated remote vaults.

aws_backup_cross_region_copy.description: For each collected AWS Backup plan in a complete same-Region inventory, inspects every valid rule in the full GetBackupPlan response. A rule satisfies the signed declaration only if at least one CopyAction names a backup vault ARN in another Region of the caller-proven AWS partition. This checks configured copy actions, not completed copies or recovery capability.
evaluated: complete scoped backup_plan inventory and BackupPlanArn
aws_backup_cross_region_copy.fail_when: At least one valid plan rule has no copy action or only proven same-Region copy destinations. An empty or missing rule list is UNKNOWN.
aws_backup_cross_region_copy.pass_when: Every backup rule declares at least one same-partition destination backup vault in a different Region.

aws_backup_failure_notification.description: Checks each AWS Backup vault's complete native notification detail for failure events and an owned SNS topic ARN.
evaluated: new read-only backup:ListBackupVaults and backup:GetBackupVaultNotifications; SNSTopicArn, BackupVaultEvents
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_backup_failure_notification.fail_when: Native detail confirms no notification or lacks the failure event or topic.
aws_backup_failure_notification.not_applicable_when: No vault subtype exclusion; denied or malformed notification reads are UNKNOWN.
aws_backup_failure_notification.pass_when: BACKUP_JOB_FAILED is selected and a same-account topic ARN is configured.

aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.description: Detects an AWS Backup plan whose ScheduleExpression is less frequent than the approved backup interval; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident.
aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.fail_when: At least one resolved rule schedule exceeds the required frequency and continuous backup does not resolve that gap.
aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.pass_when: Every parsed rule schedule meets the operator supplied frequency and no rule has unresolved continuous-backup semantics.

aws_backup_recent_restore_test.description: Detects an AWS Backup restore job whose protected resource type lacks a completed restore job within 365 days; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_recent_restore_test.
aws_backup_recent_restore_test.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each ResourceType selected by a restore testing plan has a restore job with Status=COMPLETED and CompletionDate >= now-365 days; UNKNOWN if plans or jobs are incomplete.
aws_backup_recent_restore_test.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each ResourceType selected by a restore testing plan has a restore job with Status=COMPLETED and CompletionDate >= now-365 days; UNKNOWN if plans or jobs are incomplete.

aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.description: Detects a protected resource without a completed AWS Backup restore-testing job within its test interval; application recovery still requires separate validation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.
evaluated: backup:ListRestoreJobs RestoreJobs[].SourceResourceArn, Status, CompletionDate, CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn; approved protected-resource ARN inventory and test interval.
aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each inventoried protected source resource ARN, PASS iff a restore-testing job for that SourceResourceArn has Status=COMPLETED, a nonempty CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn, and CompletionDate within its configured interval; UNKNOWN if job history or the protected-resource inventory is incomplete. Application recovery validation remains manual.
aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each inventoried protected source resource ARN, PASS iff a restore-testing job for that SourceResourceArn has Status=COMPLETED, a nonempty CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn, and CompletionDate within its configured interval; UNKNOWN if job history or the protected-resource inventory is incomplete. Application recovery validation remains manual.

aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.description: Detects a Bedrock automated reasoning policy whose Bedrock automated-reasoning policy is not attached to the scoped guardrail; a guardrail without reasoning policy cannot validate model output against the approved rules. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_attached.
evaluated: new read-only bedrock:ListAutomatedReasoningPolicies and bedrock:GetGuardrail (including versioned automatedReasoningPolicyConfig); application guardrail identifiers require workload inventory
aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope Bedrock application with a known guardrail identifier, fail if the referenced guardrail version has no configured automated reasoning policy ARN or the policy cannot be resolved as active; UNKNOWN when the application-to-guardrail binding is unavailable.
aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope Bedrock application with a known guardrail identifier, fail if the referenced guardrail version has no configured automated reasoning policy ARN or the policy cannot be resolved as active; UNKNOWN when the application-to-guardrail binding is unavailable.

aws_budgets_stop_action.description: Detects a Budgets action whose budget threshold has no service-stopping Budgets Action; unexpected spend may continue without timely action or notification. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_budgets_stop_action.
aws_budgets_stop_action.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff the configured budget has a Budgets Action with ActionStatus=STANDBY or EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS, ActionType=RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS, an approved stop document ARN, threshold and target roles; UNKNOWN without approved targets.
aws_budgets_stop_action.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the configured budget has a Budgets Action with ActionStatus=STANDBY or EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS, ActionType=RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS, an approved stop document ARN, threshold and target roles; UNKNOWN without approved targets.

aws_cis_ami_name_policy.description: Detects an owned EC2 AMI whose Name fails the approved naming expression; operators may launch an unreviewed image by mistake. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ami_name_policy.
evaluated: existing ec2_instance_image from ec2:DescribeImages Name, OwnerId, ImageId plus configured organization AMI naming expression
aws_cis_ami_name_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL for an owned AMI whose Name does not match the configured organization naming expression; UNKNOWN without that expression.
aws_cis_ami_name_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL for an owned AMI whose Name does not match the configured organization naming expression; UNKNOWN without that expression.

aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.description: Detects an AWS resource policy whose resource policy grants an unrestricted Principal without a boundary; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted_principal.
evaluated: existing resource policy documents plus read-only s3:GetBucketPolicy Policy, lambda:GetPolicy Policy, events:DescribeEventBus Policy, secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy ResourcePolicy, sns:GetTopicAttributes Policy, sqs:GetQueueAttributes Policy, kms:GetKeyPolicy Policy, apigateway:GetRestApi policy
aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement has Principal=* without an effective restrictive organization, source account, source ARN, or principal condition; UNKNOWN when a resource policy cannot be read.
aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement has Principal=* without an effective restrictive organization, source account, source ARN, or principal condition; UNKNOWN when a resource policy cannot be read.

aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.description: Detects an AWS Backup recovery point whose recovery point lacks an isolated protected copy; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.
aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each recovery point, FAIL if IsEncrypted=false or its vault has no active Vault Lock when the configured backup policy requires locked copies; UNKNOWN if vault state or independent offline copy evidence is unavailable. Physical security and offline custody remain manual.
aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each recovery point, FAIL if IsEncrypted=false or its vault has no active Vault Lock when the configured backup policy requires locked copies; UNKNOWN if vault state or independent offline copy evidence is unavailable. Physical security and offline custody remain manual.

aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.description: Checks every projected container in an active AWS Batch job definition for the awslogs driver and group option.
evaluated: identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.fail_when: At least one active job container lacks the driver or group.
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.not_applicable_when: Inactive job definitions are excluded; an unreadable container projection is UNKNOWN.
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.pass_when: Every container has logDriver=awslogs and a nonempty awslogs-group option.

aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk log option does not persist logs to S3; ephemeral instance logs can disappear when the environment is replaced. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.
evaluated: elasticbeanstalk:DescribeConfigurationSettings aws:elasticbeanstalk:hostmanager LogPublicationControl, plus s3:ListObjectsV2 in configured log bucket
aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if LogPublicationControl is not true for an active environment or no configured S3 log destination can be resolved; UNKNOWN if log publication evidence is unavailable.
aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if LogPublicationControl is not true for an active environment or no configured S3 log destination can be resolved; UNKNOWN if log publication evidence is unavailable.

aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.description: For a stable nonterminated EC2 instance in a complete native DescribeInstances inventory, joins every attached network interface security-group ID to the same-Region DescribeSecurityGroups inventory by exact VPC ID and group ID. It detects attachment of the VPC's default security group; it does not infer ingress reachability from the group name alone.
aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.fail_when: At least one attached interface group resolves to the same-VPC default security group.
aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.pass_when: Every attached interface group resolves to a same-VPC group whose GroupName is not default.

aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.description: Detects an EC2 instance whose ImageId or AMI OwnerId is outside the approved inventory; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.
evaluated: collected instance.ImageId; ec2_instance_image.ImageId, OwnerId, Tags; approved_image_ids and approved_owner_ids
aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when a running instance ImageId or image owner is absent from the configured approved AMI allowlist; UNKNOWN if the AMI metadata or allowlist is missing.
aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when a running instance ImageId or image owner is absent from the configured approved AMI allowlist; UNKNOWN if the AMI metadata or allowlist is missing.

aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.description: Detects an Organizations TAG_POLICY that omits approved EC2 tag keys or values; resource ownership and classification become unreliable. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.
aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if no attached TAG_POLICY contains the organization-approved EC2 tag keys and permitted values; UNKNOWN until required EC2 tag keys and values are configured.
aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if no attached TAG_POLICY contains the organization-approved EC2 tag keys and permitted values; UNKNOWN until required EC2 tag keys and values are configured.

aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.description: Detects an EC2 instance whose decoded user data contains credential-like literals; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.
evaluated: new read-only ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute Attribute=userData; decode UserData then inspect literal content locally without persisting it
aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if decoded user data contains a high-confidence private key, cloud credential, or password assignment with a non-placeholder literal; UNKNOWN if user data cannot be read.
aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if decoded user data contains a high-confidence private key, cloud credential, or password assignment with a non-placeholder literal; UNKNOWN if user data cannot be read.

aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk load balancer has an HTTP-only listener; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk-associated load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener with a nonempty certificate ARN/ID, or has a plaintext listener without an HTTPS redirect action; UNKNOWN if listener or association inventory is missing.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk-associated load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener with a nonempty certificate ARN/ID, or has a plaintext listener without an HTTPS redirect action; UNKNOWN if listener or association inventory is missing.

aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk load balancer has no enabled access logs; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_access_logs.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk environment names an ALB/NLB with access_logs.s3.enabled=false or a Classic ELB with AccessLog.Enabled=false; UNKNOWN if load-balancer association or attributes cannot be read.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk environment names an ALB/NLB with access_logs.s3.enabled=false or a Classic ELB with AccessLog.Enabled=false; UNKNOWN if load-balancer association or attributes cannot be read.

aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.description: Detects a load balancer whose public ALB or NLB listener uses HTTP or TCP where TLS is required; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.fail_when: At least one ALB listener accepts HTTP without a redirect or one NLB listener accepts TCP without TLS.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.not_applicable_when: The resource is a gateway load balancer rather than an ALB or NLB.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.pass_when: Every complete ALB listener uses HTTPS or every complete NLB listener uses TLS, with no unresolved listeners.

aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.description: Checks whether a running customer-managed AWS Config recorder includes Lambda functions in its regional recording group.
evaluated: existing lambda_function FunctionArn and config_recorder inventories; config:DescribeConfigurationRecorders and DescribeConfigurationRecorderStatus
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.fail_when: No customer-managed recorder exists, it is stopped, or its explicit recording group excludes Lambda.
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.not_applicable_when: No Lambda subtype exclusion; unresolved service-linked recorder coverage remains UNKNOWN.
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.pass_when: One running customer-managed recorder includes AWS::Lambda::Function.

aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.description: Detects a Lambda function whose database credential variables contain literal secrets instead of a secret ARN; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.
evaluated: lambda:ListFunctions Functions[].FunctionName,Role,Environment.Variables; iam:GetRolePolicy/GetPolicyVersion PolicyDocument.Statement; secretsmanager:ListSecrets SecretList[].ARN; approved database connection environment-variable names
aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every Lambda with an approved database connection environment-variable name, FAIL if no environment-variable value resolves to an inventoried Secrets Manager ARN, or its execution role has no Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on that ARN; UNKNOWN if role policy or environment values are unavailable. Runtime use remains manual.
aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every Lambda with an approved database connection environment-variable name, FAIL if no environment-variable value resolves to an inventoried Secrets Manager ARN, or its execution role has no Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on that ARN; UNKNOWN if role policy or environment values are unavailable. Runtime use remains manual.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.description: For each Lambda function in a complete regional ListFunctions inventory, compares the declared Role ARN to an exact ARN in the complete account-global IAM RoleDetailList. The account and AWS partition must match the audited caller identity. This proves declared role existence only, not trust policy, permissions, current credentials, or invocation success. The existing IAM GetAccountAuthorizationDetails inventory supplies the full-role equivalent of the signed proposed GetRole lookup.
evaluated: regional and global collection envelope scope/account_id/global markers
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.fail_when: The valid declared execution Role ARN is absent from a complete account-global IAM role inventory.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.pass_when: The function's exact same-account, same-partition Role ARN is present in the complete account-global IAM role inventory.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.description: Detects a Lambda function whose execution role policy grants administrator-level actions; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lambda execution role has unconditional effective Action=* and Resource=* or AdministratorAccess; UNKNOWN if policy documents are incomplete. Absence of administrator access is only a lower bound on least privilege; approved action/resource scope requires owner review.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lambda execution role has unconditional effective Action=* and Resource=* or AdministratorAccess; UNKNOWN if policy documents are incomplete. Absence of administrator access is only a lower bound on least privilege; approved action/resource scope requires owner review.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.description: For each proven active Lambda function, compares its execution Role ARN against distinct active FunctionArns observed across the account's enabled Regions. A duplicate role produces a finding even with partial peer coverage; a clean result needs complete paginated regional inventories, collected configuration State, and caller-proven account and partition. This checks declared role reuse, not effective access or privilege escalation.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.fail_when: At least two distinct observed active functions in the audited account and partition have the same exact execution role ARN; the current function is one of them.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.not_applicable_when: The function has a collected, recognized nonactive State.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.pass_when: An active function's exact role ARN is absent from the account-wide shared-role set and the account summary proves complete enabled-Region coverage.

aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.description: Detects a Lambda function whose resource policy permits invocation from an untrusted account ID; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_accounts.
evaluated: existing lambda_function Policy from lambda:GetPolicy plus configured trusted account IDs
aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement names an AWS account principal outside the trusted account set, considering PrincipalOrgID and SourceAccount conditions; UNKNOWN without the trusted set.
aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement names an AWS account principal outside the trusted account set, considering PrincipalOrgID and SourceAccount conditions; UNKNOWN without the trusted set.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.description: Checks whether each Lightsail source bucket delivers request logs to a named destination bucket.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets response buckets[].accessLogConfig.enabled, destination, prefix
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.fail_when: Access logging is disabled or has no destination.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.pass_when: Access logging is enabled with a destination bucket name.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket whose bucket IAM policy grants broader actions or resources than approved; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets arn plus iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails and iam:GetPolicyVersion policy documents and principal attachments
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required to use IAM-managed access has no policy attached to an approved principal granting only configured Lightsail bucket actions on its ARN; UNKNOWN without approved principals/actions or complete identity-policy inventory.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required to use IAM-managed access has no policy attached to an approved principal granting only configured Lightsail bucket actions on its ARN; UNKNOWN without approved principals/actions or complete identity-policy inventory.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket missing the intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; the application may lose access to required objects. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets resourcesReceivingAccess and lightsail:GetBucketAccessKeys accessKeys
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required by a Lightsail instance has no intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; UNKNOWN without a configured required instance-to-bucket relation.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required by a Lightsail instance has no intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; UNKNOWN without a configured required instance-to-bucket relation.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket whose Lightsail bucket access rules permit public reads; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.
evaluated: lightsail:GetBuckets buckets[].name,accessRules.getObject,accessRules.allowPublicOverrides; s3control:GetPublicAccessBlock PublicAccessBlockConfiguration; s3:ListObjectsV2 Contents[].Key and s3:GetObjectAcl Grants[].Grantee,Permission when public overrides are permitted
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket has accessRules.getObject=public and effective BlockPublicPolicy/RestrictPublicBuckets do not block it, or any enumerated object has AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers READ grant when public overrides are effective; UNKNOWN if account controls or object ACL inventory is incomplete.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket has accessRules.getObject=public and effective BlockPublicPolicy/RestrictPublicBuckets do not block it, or any enumerated object has AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers READ grant when public overrides are effective; UNKNOWN if account controls or object ACL inventory is incomplete.

aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.description: Detects a Lightsail instance whose Lightsail instance patch-compliance status is noncompliant; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.
aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lightsail instance matched to a managed SSM instance has MissingCount>0 or FailedCount>0 or InstalledRejectedCount>0; UNKNOWN if no reliable Lightsail-to-SSM match or patch state exists.
aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lightsail instance matched to a managed SSM instance has MissingCount>0 or FailedCount>0 or InstalledRejectedCount>0; UNKNOWN if no reliable Lightsail-to-SSM match or patch state exists.

aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.description: Detects an Organizations account whose account lacks the required effective SCP guardrail; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.
evaluated: existing organization_account and scp_policy inventories from organizations:ListAccounts, ListPoliciesForTarget, DescribePolicy
aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an active organization account has no effective attached SCP beyond FullAWSAccess, or an attached explicit guardrail policy does not cover configured prohibited actions; UNKNOWN when policy inheritance is incomplete.
aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an active organization account has no effective attached SCP beyond FullAWSAccess, or an attached explicit guardrail policy does not cover configured prohibited actions; UNKNOWN when policy inheritance is incomplete.

aws_cis_organization_units_environment_s.description: Detects an Organizations parent whose parent OU path does not encode approved environment and sensitivity; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organization_units_environment_sensitivity.
evaluated: organizations:ListAccounts Accounts[].Id,Status; organizations:ListParents Parents[].Id,Type; organizations:DescribeOrganizationalUnit OrganizationalUnit.Name,Id; configured approved environment and sensitivity OU name patterns
aws_cis_organization_units_environment_s.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every ACTIVE member account, FAIL if its parent chain has no OrganizationalUnit.Name matching an approved environment pattern or no name matching an approved sensitivity pattern; UNKNOWN without the approved patterns or a complete parent chain.
aws_cis_organization_units_environment_s.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every ACTIVE member account, FAIL if its parent chain has no OrganizationalUnit.Name matching an approved environment pattern or no name matching an approved sensitivity pattern; UNKNOWN without the approved patterns or a complete parent chain.

aws_cis_organizations_integrated_service.description: Detects an enabled Organizations service principal without an active delegated administrator; central security administration may not cover member accounts. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organizations_integrated_services_delegated.
evaluated: organizations:ListAWSServiceAccessForOrganization EnabledServicePrincipals[].ServicePrincipal; organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators Account.Id,Status with ServicePrincipal filter; configured service principals requiring delegation
aws_cis_organizations_integrated_service.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each configured required ServicePrincipal present in EnabledServicePrincipals, FAIL if ListDelegatedAdministrators filtered by that ServicePrincipal returns no ACTIVE member account; UNKNOWN if required principal list or API inventory is unavailable. Actual management activity remains manual.
aws_cis_organizations_integrated_service.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each configured required ServicePrincipal present in EnabledServicePrincipals, FAIL if ListDelegatedAdministrators filtered by that ServicePrincipal returns no ACTIVE member account; UNKNOWN if required principal list or API inventory is unavailable. Actual management activity remains manual.

aws_cis_organizations_management_account.description: Detects an Organizations account whose Organizations management account hosts in-scope workload resources; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organizations_management_account_workloads.
evaluated: organizations:DescribeOrganization Organization.ManagementAccountId; ec2:DescribeInstances Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId,Tags; rds:DescribeDBInstances DBInstances[].DBInstanceIdentifier,TagList; lambda:ListFunctions Functions[].FunctionArn; ecs:ListClusters clusterArns and ListServices serviceArns; eks:ListClusters clusters[]; caller account ID and configured governance resource allowlist
aws_cis_organizations_management_account.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if the caller account equals Organization.ManagementAccountId and an EC2 instance, RDS DB instance, Lambda function, ECS service, or EKS cluster identifier is absent from the approved governance resource allowlist; UNKNOWN if account identity, resource inventory, or allowlist is unavailable. Workload purpose still needs owner review.
aws_cis_organizations_management_account.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if the caller account equals Organization.ManagementAccountId and an EC2 instance, RDS DB instance, Lambda function, ECS service, or EKS cluster identifier is absent from the approved governance resource allowlist; UNKNOWN if account identity, resource inventory, or allowlist is unavailable. Workload purpose still needs owner review.

aws_cis_organizations_policy_management_.description: Detects an AWS Organization whose policy-management delegate differs from the approved account; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organizations_policy_management_delegated.
evaluated: organizations:DescribeResourcePolicy ResourcePolicy.Content JSON Statement.Principal, Action, Resource, Effect; organizations:DescribeOrganization Id and ManagementAccountId; organizations:ListAccounts Accounts[].Id,Status
aws_cis_organizations_policy_management_.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if ResourcePolicy.Content has no Allow statement granting an active non-management account principal organizations:CreatePolicy, UpdatePolicy, and AttachPolicy on this organization; UNKNOWN if the policy cannot be read. Actual use by the delegated account requires audit evidence.
aws_cis_organizations_policy_management_.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if ResourcePolicy.Content has no Allow statement granting an active non-management account principal organizations:CreatePolicy, UpdatePolicy, and AttachPolicy on this organization; UNKNOWN if the policy cannot be read. Actual use by the delegated account requires audit evidence.

aws_cis_route53_dns_firewall.description: Detects a VPC without an active DNS Firewall rule-group association; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_route53_dns_firewall.
aws_cis_route53_dns_firewall.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope VPC, FAIL if no association has matching VpcId, Status=COMPLETE and a rule group containing at least one BLOCK rule for an approved FirewallDomainListId; UNKNOWN without the approved domain-list IDs. Other DNS protection remains manual.
aws_cis_route53_dns_firewall.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope VPC, FAIL if no association has matching VpcId, Status=COMPLETE and a rule group containing at least one BLOCK rule for an approved FirewallDomainListId; UNKNOWN without the approved domain-list IDs. Other DNS protection remains manual.

aws_cis_s3_macie_classification_coverage.description: Detects a S3 bucket whose S3 ARN lacks active Macie discovery coverage; unclassified S3 data may remain undiscovered and unprotected. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_s3_macie_classification_coverage.
evaluated: s3:ListAllMyBuckets Buckets[].Name; macie2:GetMacieSession status; macie2:GetAutomatedDiscoveryConfiguration status; macie2:ListClassificationJobs jobId; macie2:DescribeClassificationJob status, s3JobDefinition.bucketDefinitions[].accountId,buckets[] and bucketCriteria.includes/excludes
aws_cis_s3_macie_classification_coverage.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every inventoried bucket, FAIL if automated discovery status is not ENABLED and no classification job with status RUNNING or COMPLETE selects that bucket via bucketDefinitions or bucketCriteria includes minus excludes; UNKNOWN if any selection rule or job status cannot be resolved. Findings remediation remains manual.
aws_cis_s3_macie_classification_coverage.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every inventoried bucket, FAIL if automated discovery status is not ENABLED and no classification job with status RUNNING or COMPLETE selects that bucket via bucketDefinitions or bucketCriteria includes minus excludes; UNKNOWN if any selection rule or job status cannot be resolved. Findings remediation remains manual.

aws_cis_vpc_service_endpoints_required.description: Detects a VPC missing a required in-use AWS service VPC endpoint; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_vpc_service_endpoints_required.
evaluated: ec2:DescribeVpcs Vpcs[].VpcId; ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints VpcEndpoints[].VpcId,ServiceName,State,VpcEndpointType; configured required service names per VPC
aws_cis_vpc_service_endpoints_required.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each VPC and configured required service name, FAIL if no endpoint in that VPC has matching ServiceName and State=available; UNKNOWN without a required-service list. Actual private route use remains manual.
aws_cis_vpc_service_endpoints_required.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each VPC and configured required service name, FAIL if no endpoint in that VPC has matching ServiceName and State=available; UNKNOWN without a required-service list. Actual private route use remains manual.

aws_client_vpn_authentication_configured.description: Checks that available Client VPN endpoints declare a server certificate and supported client authentication.
evaluated: identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_client_vpn_authentication_configured.fail_when: An available endpoint lacks a server certificate or authentication method.
aws_client_vpn_authentication_configured.not_applicable_when: Endpoints in known nonavailable states are excluded.
aws_client_vpn_authentication_configured.pass_when: An available endpoint has a server certificate and at least one recognized authentication method.

aws_cloudfront_origin_failover_configure.description: For a collected CloudFront distribution, checks that each declared origin group has two distinct existing origin IDs and at least one provider-supported failover status code. This signed predicate evaluates declared groups; it does not establish that a cache behavior references a group.
aws_cloudfront_origin_failover_configure.fail_when: OriginGroups is omitted or has zero groups in a complete distribution configuration, or any complete group has missing/duplicate origin members or no status codes.
aws_cloudfront_origin_failover_configure.pass_when: At least one group exists and every group has exactly two distinct member origin IDs present in the distribution origin inventory and a nonempty list containing only provider-supported status codes.

aws_cloudtrail_administration_command.description: Detects successful SSM SendCommand, StartAutomationExecution or StartSession events by unapproved principals; unauthorized remote administration can change or inspect workloads. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudtrail_administration_command.
evaluated: cloudtrail:LookupEvents Events[].EventName, EventTime, Username, CloudTrailEvent.userIdentity.arn, errorCode, requestParameters; approved_remote_administration_principals
aws_cloudtrail_administration_command.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Flag a successful SendCommand, StartAutomationExecution or StartSession event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved remote-administration principal set; UNKNOWN if event history or allowlist is incomplete.
aws_cloudtrail_administration_command.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Flag a successful SendCommand, StartAutomationExecution or StartSession event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved remote-administration principal set; UNKNOWN if event history or allowlist is incomplete.

aws_cloudtrail_bucket_lifecycle_retentio.description: Detects a CloudTrail trail whose CloudTrail destination lifecycle expires log versions before 365 days; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudtrail_bucket_lifecycle_retention_365.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails, s3:GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration, s3:GetObjectLockConfiguration; S3BucketName, S3KeyPrefix, Rules, ObjectLockEnabled, DefaultRetention
aws_cloudtrail_bucket_lifecycle_retentio.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each logging trail, fail if a matching enabled lifecycle rule can delete current or noncurrent audit objects before 365 days; pass only when Object Lock default retention is at least 365 days and no earlier expiration applies; UNKNOWN if prefix overlap, lifecycle or Object Lock state is unavailable. This evaluates configured retention, not immutable delivery history.
aws_cloudtrail_bucket_lifecycle_retentio.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each logging trail, fail if a matching enabled lifecycle rule can delete current or noncurrent audit objects before 365 days; pass only when Object Lock default retention is at least 365 days and no earlier expiration applies; UNKNOWN if prefix overlap, lifecycle or Object Lock state is unavailable. This evaluates configured retention, not immutable delivery history.

aws_cloudtrail_event_triggered_execution.description: Detects successful EventBridge PutRule or PutTargets events by unapproved principals; unauthorized rules can trigger unapproved automation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudtrail_event_triggered_execution.
evaluated: new read-only API call cloudtrail:LookupEvents filtered by the listed EventName values, with EventName, EventTime, CloudTrailEvent.userIdentity, and errorCode; existing aws_cloudtrail_activity collector is limited to a fixed event-name set and cannot substitute
aws_cloudtrail_event_triggered_execution.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Flag a successful PutRule or PutTargets event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved event-automation principal set; UNKNOWN if the allowlist or management-event history is incomplete.
aws_cloudtrail_event_triggered_execution.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Flag a successful PutRule or PutTargets event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved event-automation principal set; UNKNOWN if the allowlist or management-event history is incomplete.

aws_cloudtrail_permission_group_discover.description: Detects successful IAM group-listing events by unapproved principals; unexpected enumeration can indicate privilege reconnaissance. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudtrail_permission_group_discovery.
evaluated: new read-only API call cloudtrail:LookupEvents filtered by the listed EventName values, with EventName, EventTime, CloudTrailEvent.userIdentity, and errorCode; existing aws_cloudtrail_activity collector is limited to a fixed event-name set and cannot substitute
aws_cloudtrail_permission_group_discover.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Flag a successful ListGroups, GetGroup or ListAttachedGroupPolicies management event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved IAM-inventory principal set; UNKNOWN if event history or allowlist is incomplete.
aws_cloudtrail_permission_group_discover.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Flag a successful ListGroups, GetGroup or ListAttachedGroupPolicies management event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved IAM-inventory principal set; UNKNOWN if event history or allowlist is incomplete.

aws_cloudtrail_s3_siem_delivery.description: Detects a CloudTrail trail whose CloudTrail destination lacks the approved S3 or SIEM delivery path; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudtrail_s3_siem_delivery.
evaluated: cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus LatestDeliveryTime, LatestDeliveryError; cloudtrail:DescribeTrails S3BucketName; s3:ListObjectsV2 Contents[].LastModified under AWSLogs prefix; approved AWS SIEM-forwarder ARN inventory
aws_cloudtrail_s3_siem_delivery.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every inventoried organization trail, PASS iff LatestDeliveryError is empty, LatestDeliveryTime is within 24 hours and its S3BucketName contains an AWSLogs object with LastModified within 24 hours; SIEM receipt remains manual.
aws_cloudtrail_s3_siem_delivery.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every inventoried organization trail, PASS iff LatestDeliveryError is empty, LatestDeliveryTime is within 24 hours and its S3BucketName contains an AWSLogs object with LastModified within 24 hours; SIEM receipt remains manual.

aws_cloudwatch_alarm_missing_data_realer.description: Detects a CloudWatch alarm whose TreatMissingData or evaluation window suppresses an inactivity alert; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudwatch_alarm_missing_data_realert.
aws_cloudwatch_alarm_missing_data_realer.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each configured inactivity metric has a CloudWatch alarm with TreatMissingData=breaching, Period*EvaluationPeriods <= approved_interval_seconds, ActionsEnabled=true and nonempty AlarmActions.
aws_cloudwatch_alarm_missing_data_realer.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each configured inactivity metric has a CloudWatch alarm with TreatMissingData=breaching, Period*EvaluationPeriods <= approved_interval_seconds, ActionsEnabled=true and nonempty AlarmActions.

aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm_has_threshol.description: Detects a CloudWatch alarm whose Threshold or ComparisonOperator differs from the approved metric limit; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm_has_threshold.
evaluated: existing collected type cloudwatch_alarm + Threshold, ComparisonOperator, MetricName/Namespace or Metrics[] and an organization-configured threshold policy per metric
aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm_has_threshol.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS when each in-scope alarm Threshold and ComparisonOperator meet the configured allowed range/operator for its namespace and metric; FAIL on a mismatch; UNKNOWN when the approved policy or alarm fields are unavailable.
aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm_has_threshol.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS when each in-scope alarm Threshold and ComparisonOperator meet the configured allowed range/operator for its namespace and metric; FAIL on a mismatch; UNKNOWN when the approved policy or alarm fields are unavailable.

aws_cloudwatchlogs_cloud_storage_staging.description: Detects successful PutObject or CopyObject events to designated staging buckets by unapproved principals; unauthorized writes can alter or exfiltrate staged data. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudwatchlogs_cloud_storage_staging.
evaluated: new read-only API call logs:FilterLogEvents against configured CloudTrail data-event log groups, with eventName, eventTime, userIdentity, errorCode, and resource ARN; require data-event selectors and complete log retention
aws_cloudwatchlogs_cloud_storage_staging.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Flag a successful PutObject or CopyObject data event to a designated staging bucket when userIdentity.arn is outside its approved writer set; UNKNOWN if staging buckets, selectors or retained events are unavailable.
aws_cloudwatchlogs_cloud_storage_staging.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Flag a successful PutObject or CopyObject data event to a designated staging bucket when userIdentity.arn is outside its approved writer set; UNKNOWN if staging buckets, selectors or retained events are unavailable.

aws_cloudwatchlogs_information_repositor.description: Detects successful GetSecretValue, GetObject or ExecuteStatement events by unapproved principals against scoped repositories; unauthorized reads can expose sensitive records or secrets. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cloudwatchlogs_information_repository_read.
evaluated: new read-only API call logs:FilterLogEvents against configured CloudTrail data-event log groups, with eventName, eventTime, userIdentity, errorCode, and resource ARN; require data-event selectors and complete log retention
aws_cloudwatchlogs_information_repositor.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Flag a successful GetSecretValue, GetObject or ExecuteStatement data event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved data-access principal set; UNKNOWN unless the relevant data-event selectors and retained log groups are complete.
aws_cloudwatchlogs_information_repositor.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Flag a successful GetSecretValue, GetObject or ExecuteStatement data event whose userIdentity.arn is outside the approved data-access principal set; UNKNOWN unless the relevant data-event selectors and retained log groups are complete.

aws_cognito_session_expiry.description: Detects a Cognito user-pool client whose user-pool client token lifetime exceeds the approved expiry; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cognito_session_expiry.
evaluated: new read-only cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient; AccessTokenValidity, IdTokenValidity, RefreshTokenValidity, TokenValidityUnits
aws_cognito_session_expiry.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff all in-scope clients have access and ID tokens no longer than 60 minutes and refresh token no longer than approved policy; FAIL otherwise.
aws_cognito_session_expiry.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff all in-scope clients have access and ID tokens no longer than 60 minutes and refresh token no longer than approved policy; FAIL otherwise.

aws_config_all_resources_recorded.description: Evaluates each collected AWS account/Region scope for one customer-managed AWS Config recorder that is recording with lastStatus Success and records all supported resource types; a missing, stopped, failed or type-restricted recorder can hide configuration changes and security events. Pending or NotApplicable status, denied or incomplete collection and ambiguous recorder ownership are reported UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete config_recorder regional collection (DescribeConfigurationRecorders without arguments)
aws_config_all_resources_recorded.fail_when: The complete regional inventory has no customer-managed recorder, the recorder is stopped or reports lastStatus Failure, or its recording group is restricted by inclusion, exclusion or legacy selected resource types.
aws_config_all_resources_recorded.pass_when: Exactly one customer-managed recorder in the Region is recording, its matching status reports lastStatus Success, allSupported is true, recordingStrategy.useOnly is absent or ALL_SUPPORTED_RESOURCE_TYPES, and no included or excluded resource types are listed.

aws_config_continuous_inventory.description: For a regional AWS Config recorder, checks the matching recorder status, all-supported recording group flag, default recording frequency, and every resource-type frequency override. A paused, narrowed, or daily recorder does not provide the requested continuous inventory.
aws_config_continuous_inventory.fail_when: A complete matching recorder has recording=false, allSupported=false, default recordingFrequency=DAILY, or any DAILY resource-type override.
aws_config_continuous_inventory.pass_when: The matching recorder is recording, allSupported is true, and default and all override frequencies are CONTINUOUS.

aws_config_recorder_all_supported_resour.description: For a collected AWS Config recorder, checks whether its recording group covers all supported resource types, including a zero-exclusion exclusion strategy. A narrower inclusion or nonempty exclusion list leaves resources unrecorded.
aws_config_recorder_all_supported_resour.fail_when: The legacy allSupported flag is false, explicit inclusion is selected, or the exclusion strategy lists any resource type.
aws_config_recorder_all_supported_resour.pass_when: allSupported is true under the legacy or ALL_SUPPORTED_RESOURCE_TYPES strategy, or EXCLUSION_BY_RESOURCE_TYPES has an empty exclusion list.

aws_controltower_landing_zone_active.description: Detects a Control Tower landing zone whose Control Tower landing-zone status is not ACTIVE; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_controltower_landing_zone_active.
evaluated: new read-only API call controltower:ListLandingZones + GetLandingZone with status
aws_controltower_landing_zone_active.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Fail if no landing zone is ACTIVE for an organization hosting in-scope AI accounts; unknown if account-to-organization linkage is unavailable.
aws_controltower_landing_zone_active.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Fail if no landing zone is ACTIVE for an organization hosting in-scope AI accounts; unknown if account-to-organization linkage is unavailable.

aws_costexplorer_anomaly_alert.description: Detects a Cost Explorer anomaly monitor whose cost anomaly monitor has no thresholded alert subscription; unexpected spend may continue without timely action or notification. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_costexplorer_anomaly_alert.
evaluated: new read-only ce:GetAnomalyMonitors, ce:GetAnomalySubscriptions; events:ListRules, events:ListTargetsByRule for raised events
aws_costexplorer_anomaly_alert.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff a Cost Explorer anomaly subscription references an active monitor, has a nonempty ThresholdExpression and Subscribers[], and its notification target matches the approved recipient inventory.
aws_costexplorer_anomaly_alert.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff a Cost Explorer anomaly subscription references an active monitor, has a nonempty ThresholdExpression and Subscribers[], and its notification target matches the approved recipient inventory.

aws_costexplorer_prod_anomaly_monitor.description: Detects a Cost Explorer anomaly monitor whose Prod tag monitor has no thresholded alert subscription; unexpected spend may continue without timely action or notification. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_costexplorer_prod_anomaly_monitor.
evaluated: ce:GetAnomalyMonitors AnomalyMonitors[].MonitorArn, MonitorSpecification, MonitorType; ce:GetAnomalySubscriptions AnomalySubscriptions[].MonitorArn, Subscribers[], ThresholdExpression
aws_costexplorer_prod_anomaly_monitor.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff a monitor MonitorSpecification filters the approved cost-allocation tag value Prod and a subscription references its MonitorArn with at least one Subscriber and a nonempty ThresholdExpression.
aws_costexplorer_prod_anomaly_monitor.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff a monitor MonitorSpecification filters the approved cost-allocation tag value Prod and a subscription references its MonitorArn with at least one Subscriber and a nonempty ThresholdExpression.

aws_costexplorer_qa_anomaly_monitor.description: Detects a Cost Explorer anomaly monitor whose QA tag monitor has no thresholded alert subscription; unexpected spend may continue without timely action or notification. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_costexplorer_qa_anomaly_monitor.
evaluated: ce:GetAnomalyMonitors AnomalyMonitors[].MonitorArn, MonitorSpecification, MonitorType; ce:GetAnomalySubscriptions AnomalySubscriptions[].MonitorArn, Subscribers[], ThresholdExpression
aws_costexplorer_qa_anomaly_monitor.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff a monitor MonitorSpecification filters the approved cost-allocation tag value QA and a subscription references its MonitorArn with at least one Subscriber and a nonempty ThresholdExpression.
aws_costexplorer_qa_anomaly_monitor.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff a monitor MonitorSpecification filters the approved cost-allocation tag value QA and a subscription references its MonitorArn with at least one Subscriber and a nonempty ThresholdExpression.

aws_detective_ai_account_graph_enabled.description: Detects a Detective graph whose scoped account is absent from the enabled Detective graph; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_detective_ai_account_graph_enabled.
evaluated: detective:ListGraphs GraphList[].Arn and GraphList[].CreatedTime in each in-scope account and region
aws_detective_ai_account_graph_enabled.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an in-scope AI workload account/region has zero returned Detective GraphList entries with a nonempty Arn; UNKNOWN if the account/region inventory or ListGraphs result is unavailable.
aws_detective_ai_account_graph_enabled.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an in-scope AI workload account/region has zero returned Detective GraphList entries with a nonempty Arn; UNKNOWN if the account/region inventory or ListGraphs result is unavailable.

aws_development_backup_assignment.description: Detects an AWS Backup selection whose development resource ARN is absent from AWS Backup selections; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_development_backup_assignment.
evaluated: backup:ListBackupPlans, backup:GetBackupPlan, backup:ListBackupSelections, backup:GetBackupSelection; approved development resource tags
aws_development_backup_assignment.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every approved development resource is selected by a scheduled AWS Backup plan; UNKNOWN without development resource inventory.
aws_development_backup_assignment.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every approved development resource is selected by a scheduled AWS Backup plan; UNKNOWN without development resource inventory.

aws_ebs_snapshot_trusted_accounts.description: Detects an EBS snapshot whose EBS createVolumePermission includes an untrusted account ID; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_ebs_snapshot_trusted_accounts.
evaluated: new read-only API calls ec2:DescribeSnapshotAttribute; CreateVolumePermissions[].UserId plus configured trusted account IDs
aws_ebs_snapshot_trusted_accounts.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every account ID allowed to create a volume from an owned snapshot is in the configured trusted account allowlist and group all is absent
aws_ebs_snapshot_trusted_accounts.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every account ID allowed to create a volume from an owned snapshot is in the configured trusted account allowlist and group all is absent

aws_ec2_ai_nitro_instance_type.description: Detects an EC2 instance whose EC2 InstanceType is outside the approved Nitro family; a non-Nitro hypervisor lacks the approved hardware isolation properties. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_ec2_ai_nitro_instance_type.

aws_guardduty_no_active_high_findings.pass_when: At least one enabled detector exists and complete scoped finding facts contain no unarchived finding in the signed high interval for the requested account/Region.

aws_guardduty_siem_forwarding.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the union of ENABLED EventPattern rules covers aws.guardduty GuardDuty Finding events without severity exclusion and at least one target ARN is in the approved AWS SIEM-forwarder ARN inventory; SIEM receipt remains manual.

aws_iam_departed_identity_disabled.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every IAM user on the approved departure roster has password_enabled=false and both access_key_*_active=false by the recorded termination deadline; UNKNOWN without the roster or deadline.

aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after.description: Detects IAM users whose credentials remain active beyond the approved inactivity interval. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after_policy_days.
evaluated: iam:GenerateCredentialReport/GetCredentialReport user, user_creation_time, password_enabled, password_last_used, access_key_1_active, access_key_1_last_used_date, access_key_1_last_rotated, access_key_2_active, access_key_2_last_used_date, access_key_2_last_rotated; iam:ListUsers user names; required inactivity_days and approved service-account exclusions

FAIL if days since that date exceeds inactivity_days and password_enabled is true or either access_key_*_active is true. PASS if every over-threshold user has all credentials disabled. UNKNOWN if the credential report is stale, dates are unavailable, scope/exclusions or inactivity_days are missing. This snapshot does not prove automatic disabling; verify automation separately.
aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every non-excluded IAM user, compute last activity as the latest real password or access-key use date; for never-used active credentials use the later of user creation and key rotation as the start date. aws_incident_workflow_sla.description: Reviews HIGH and CRITICAL Security Hub finding metadata and the explicitly supplied response window. Current finding metadata cannot establish the first workflow response time; expired windows remain UNKNOWN until complete workflow transition history is available.

Snapshot created_at and explicitly supplied compliance_parameters.approved_response_hours (stored as metadata.parameters)
Workflow transition history is not currently collected; UpdatedAt does not substitute for that history.
aws_incident_workflow_sla.fail_when: Not emitted by the current metadata-only implementation: current Workflow.Status and provider UpdatedAt cannot prove a missed first-response deadline.

aws_incident_workflow_sla.pass_when: Not emitted by the current metadata-only implementation: complete workflow transition history is required to prove an in-time first response.

aws_inspector2_ec2_no_high_critical_find.description: Checks the complete regional ACTIVE ListFindings inventory for HIGH or CRITICAL findings on AWS_EC2_INSTANCE resources at the snapshot capture time. Missing, denied, partial, malformed, duplicate or foreign required inventory facts, and a missing or invalid timezone-aware capture time, remain UNKNOWN; disabled coverage makes a clean result UNKNOWN. An observed qualifying finding can FAIL without enabled coverage evidence. This check does not certify each instance's scan freshness or remediation.
evaluated: complete scoped inspector2_finding inventory from paginated ACTIVE ListFindings
findingArn, status, severity, awsAccountId and resources[].type
aws_inspector2_ec2_no_high_critical_find.fail_when: With valid scoped finding inventory and capture time, at least one ACTIVE finding in the assessed account and Region names an AWS_EC2_INSTANCE resource and has severity HIGH or CRITICAL; account coverage is not required for this FAIL.
aws_inspector2_ec2_no_high_critical_find.pass_when: With a valid timezone-aware capture time, complete valid same-account regional ACTIVE findings contain no HIGH or CRITICAL EC2 finding, and a complete unique same-account regional status record explicitly shows both account and EC2 coverage ENABLED.

aws_kms_compromised_key_restricted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every key tagged Compromised=true is disabled or its policy denies Encrypt and GenerateDataKey while retaining only scoped Decrypt/Verify grants; FAIL otherwise.
