aws_log_archive_immutable.description: Detects a S3 bucket whose CloudTrail archive bucket lacks versioning or default Object Lock retention; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_log_archive_immutable.
aws_log_archive_immutable.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each CloudTrail destination bucket has ObjectLockEnabled=Enabled, versioning Status=Enabled and a nonempty default retention rule; FAIL otherwise. Other log destinations remain uncovered.
aws_log_archive_immutable.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each CloudTrail destination bucket has ObjectLockEnabled=Enabled, versioning Status=Enabled and a nonempty default retention rule; FAIL otherwise. Other log destinations remain uncovered.

aws_log_clock_sync_compliance.description: Detects an SSM managed instance whose host time-sync association is missing or noncompliant; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_log_clock_sync_compliance.
evaluated: ssm:ListComplianceItems Type=Custom:TimeSync; ResourceId, Status, ExecutionSummary.ExecutionTime, Details.offsetMilliseconds; approved logging-host instance ID inventory
aws_log_clock_sync_compliance.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every designated logging host has a COMPLIANT Custom:TimeSync item updated within 24 hours with absolute offsetMilliseconds <= 1000; UNKNOWN without host inventory or custom producer.
aws_log_clock_sync_compliance.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every designated logging host has a COMPLIANT Custom:TimeSync item updated within 24 hours with absolute offsetMilliseconds <= 1000; UNKNOWN without host inventory or custom producer.

aws_log_retention_upper_bound.description: Detects a CloudWatch log group whose log-group retentionInDays exceeds the approved purpose limit; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_log_retention_upper_bound.
evaluated: logs:DescribeLogGroups; logGroupName, retentionInDays; approved per-purpose maximum retention table
aws_log_retention_upper_bound.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope log group has retentionInDays set and the value is <= its approved purpose maximum; UNKNOWN without purpose mapping or maximum.
aws_log_retention_upper_bound.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope log group has retentionInDays set and the value is <= its approved purpose maximum; UNKNOWN without purpose mapping or maximum.

aws_logging_service_multi_az.description: Detects an OpenSearch domain whose OpenSearch domain has fewer than two enabled availability zones; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_logging_service_multi_az.
aws_logging_service_multi_az.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff the designated OpenSearch SIEM domain has ZoneAwarenessEnabled=true and AvailabilityZoneCount >= 2; UNKNOWN if no designated domain.
aws_logging_service_multi_az.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the designated OpenSearch SIEM domain has ZoneAwarenessEnabled=true and AvailabilityZoneCount >= 2; UNKNOWN if no designated domain.

aws_malware_definitions_fresh.description: Detects an SSM managed instance whose reported antimalware signature timestamp exceeds the freshness limit; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_malware_definitions_fresh.
evaluated: ssm:ListComplianceItems for Type=Custom:MalwareDefinitions; Status, ExecutionSummary.ExecutionTime, Details.definitionVersion; approved managed-instance inventory
aws_malware_definitions_fresh.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated managed instance has a COMPLIANT Custom:MalwareDefinitions item with nonempty definitionVersion and ExecutionTime within 24 hours; UNKNOWN if the custom compliance producer is not installed.
aws_malware_definitions_fresh.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated managed instance has a COMPLIANT Custom:MalwareDefinitions item with nonempty definitionVersion and ExecutionTime within 24 hours; UNKNOWN if the custom compliance producer is not installed.

aws_msk_in_cluster_tls_enabled.description: Checks broker-to-broker encryption on provisioned MSK clusters.
evaluated: kafka:DescribeCluster ClusterInfo.Provisioned.EncryptionInfo.EncryptionInTransit.InCluster for every provisioned MSK cluster; kafka:DescribeClusterV2 ClusterInfo.Provisioned.EncryptionInfo.EncryptionInTransit.InCluster where V2 is used
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_msk_in_cluster_tls_enabled.fail_when: The matching provisioned cluster reports InCluster=false.
aws_msk_in_cluster_tls_enabled.not_applicable_when: Serverless clusters have no provisioned broker encryption field.
aws_msk_in_cluster_tls_enabled.pass_when: The matching provisioned cluster reports InCluster=true.

aws_nist_acm_certificate_expires_30_days.description: Checks issued ACM certificates from a complete regional inventory for an expiry strictly earlier than 30 days after capture. Eligibility does not exclude certificates.
aws_nist_acm_certificate_expires_30_days.fail_when: This issued certificate expires strictly before the capture instant plus 30 days.
aws_nist_acm_certificate_expires_30_days.not_applicable_when: The certificate Status is a recognized value other than ISSUED.
aws_nist_acm_certificate_expires_30_days.pass_when: Every applicable issued certificate has readable expiry detail and this certificate expires at or after the capture instant plus 30 days.

aws_nist_apigateway_stage_cache_encrypti.description: The wildcard setting can be overridden by an unencrypted method cache. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_apigateway_stage_cache_encryption_at_rest_enabled.
evaluated: apigateway:GetStages methodSettings for each REST API stage
aws_nist_apigateway_stage_cache_encrypti.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every effective stage method setting after wildcard and method overrides, FAIL if cachingEnabled=true and cacheDataEncrypted is not true; PASS only if every enabled cache is encrypted; UNKNOWN on incomplete method inventory.
aws_nist_apigateway_stage_cache_encrypti.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every effective stage method setting after wildcard and method overrides, FAIL if cachingEnabled=true and cacheDataEncrypted is not true; PASS only if every enabled cache is encrypted; UNKNOWN on incomplete method inventory.

aws_nist_apigateway_stage_logging_enable.description: Method overrides with logging disabled remain untested. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_apigateway_stage_logging_enabled.
evaluated: apigateway:GetStages methodSettings and accessLogSettings for every REST/HTTP stage
aws_nist_apigateway_stage_logging_enable.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope stage and every effective method setting after wildcard and method overrides, PASS only if loggingLevel is INFO or ERROR; FAIL if any effective method is OFF or missing logging, and UNKNOWN on incomplete stage/method inventory.
aws_nist_apigateway_stage_logging_enable.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope stage and every effective method setting after wildcard and method overrides, PASS only if loggingLevel is INFO or ERROR; FAIL if any effective method is OFF or missing logging, and UNKNOWN on incomplete stage/method inventory.

aws_nist_autoscaling_use_multiple_instan.description: Checks the signed EC2 auto scaling groups should use multiple instance types in multiple availability zones predicate on identity-bound read-only AWS snapshot facts; unavailable detail or unresolved applicability remains UNKNOWN.
evaluated: same-account and same-Region resource inventory and per-field collection coverage
aws_nist_autoscaling_use_multiple_instan.fail_when: The measured group has fewer than two distinct zones or its resolved explicit mixed overrides contain only one instance type.
aws_nist_autoscaling_use_multiple_instan.pass_when: At least two distinct AvailabilityZones and at least two explicit override instance types are collected.

aws_nist_backup_plan_min_retention_35_da.description: Evaluates each collected AWS Backup plan in its audited account/Region for at least one rule whose cron schedule creates recovery points at least as often as the operator-declared interval and whose lifecycle keeps them at least 35 days; without such a rule the plan cannot meet the backup frequency and 35-day retention objective. The interval is operator policy, never a default, and results describe configured coverage rather than observed backups.
aws_nist_backup_plan_min_retention_35_da.fail_when: Every rule of the plan is proven to run less often than the operator-declared interval or to expire recovery points in fewer than 35 days, or the plan has no rules.
aws_nist_backup_plan_min_retention_35_da.pass_when: At least one rule has a bounded cron schedule whose maximum gap is within the operator-declared interval and keeps recovery points 35 days or longer, including rules without an expiry.

aws_nist_cloudformation_stack_drift_dete.description: A stored IN_SYNC state does not establish that drift detection is current. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_cloudformation_stack_drift_detection_check.
aws_nist_cloudformation_stack_drift_dete.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope stack, PASS only if a completed drift detection is within the approved maximum age and its StackDriftStatus=IN_SYNC; UNKNOWN without an approved age threshold or completed detection.
aws_nist_cloudformation_stack_drift_dete.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope stack, PASS only if a completed drift detection is within the approved maximum age and its StackDriftStatus=IN_SYNC; UNKNOWN without an approved age threshold or completed detection.

aws_nist_cloudtrail_s3_logging_enabled.description: Checks the S3 destination bucket for every home-Region trail that GetTrailStatus confirms is logging.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails S3BucketName across all Regions; s3:GetBucketLogging for each distinct destination bucket
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_nist_cloudtrail_s3_logging_enabled.fail_when: Its resolved bucket has no LoggingEnabled target.
aws_nist_cloudtrail_s3_logging_enabled.not_applicable_when: Trails confirmed not logging are excluded; incomplete trail status or unresolved bucket identity is UNKNOWN.
aws_nist_cloudtrail_s3_logging_enabled.pass_when: Its resolved bucket has a LoggingEnabled target.

aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_integrated_wit.description: Recent delivery is an activity-dependent signal; configured and usable CloudWatch Logs integration remains untested. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_integrated_with_logs.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn/CloudWatchLogsRoleArn; logs:DescribeLogGroups and IAM role trust/permissions
aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_integrated_wit.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every logging trail, PASS only if both CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn and CloudWatchLogsRoleArn are nonempty, the log group exists, and the role trusts CloudTrail and permits logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents to it; UNKNOWN on incomplete reads.
aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_integrated_wit.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every logging trail, PASS only if both CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn and CloudWatchLogsRoleArn are nonempty, the log group exists, and the role trusts CloudTrail and permits logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents to it; UNKNOWN on incomplete reads.

aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_logs_encrypted.description: Checks each logging home-Region trail and any configured CloudWatch log destination for enabled customer-managed key metadata.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails KmsKeyId, CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn; logs:DescribeLogGroups kmsKeyId; kms:DescribeKey KeyManager/KeyState
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_logs_encrypted.fail_when: A resolved trail or linked group lacks an enabled customer-managed key.
aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_logs_encrypted.not_applicable_when: Nonlogging and shadow trails are excluded; unresolved reference joins are UNKNOWN.
aws_nist_cloudtrail_trail_logs_encrypted.pass_when: The trail and linked group resolve to enabled customer-managed keys.

aws_nist_cloudwatch_alarm_action_enabled.description: For a CloudWatch metric alarm, checks that ActionsEnabled is true and at least one complete ALARM, OK or INSUFFICIENT_DATA action list contains an ARN. A configured ARN cannot invoke while actions are disabled.
aws_nist_cloudwatch_alarm_action_enabled.fail_when: ActionsEnabled is false or all three complete state-action lists are empty.
aws_nist_cloudwatch_alarm_action_enabled.pass_when: ActionsEnabled is true and at least one of the three state-action lists is nonempty.

aws_nist_codebuild_project_plaintext_env.description: The existing name heuristic misses sensitive values under other names. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_codebuild_project_plaintext_env_variables_no_sensitive_aws_values.
aws_nist_codebuild_project_plaintext_env.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every project, FAIL if any PLAINTEXT variable matches an approved secret value or sensitive name pattern; UNKNOWN when the required policy inputs are unavailable.
aws_nist_codebuild_project_plaintext_env.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every project, FAIL if any PLAINTEXT variable matches an approved secret value or sensitive name pattern; UNKNOWN when the required policy inputs are unavailable.

aws_nist_config_enabled_all_regions.description: A local recorder status alone does not establish all-Region, all-resource recording. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_config_enabled_all_regions.
evaluated: config:DescribeConfigurationRecorders, DescribeConfigurationRecorderStatus, DescribeDeliveryChannels in every enabled account Region
aws_nist_config_enabled_all_regions.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every enabled Region, PASS only if a recorder exists, recording=true, all supported resource types including global types where supported are selected, and a delivery channel exists; UNKNOWN if Region inventory is incomplete.
aws_nist_config_enabled_all_regions.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every enabled Region, PASS only if a recorder exists, recording=true, all supported resource types including global types where supported are selected, and a delivery channel exists; UNKNOWN if Region inventory is incomplete.

aws_nist_dynamodb_table_encrypted_with_k.description: Checks each DynamoDB table's server-side encryption key and enabled state.
evaluated: identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_nist_dynamodb_table_encrypted_with_k.fail_when: The table has AES256, no KMS key, or a nonenabled encryption state.
aws_nist_dynamodb_table_encrypted_with_k.pass_when: The table reports SSEType=KMS, a key ARN and Status=ENABLED.

aws_nist_ec2_instance_not_publicly_acces.description: IPv6, internet-facing load-balancer exposure and reachable ingress remain untested. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_ec2_instance_not_publicly_accessible.
evaluated: ec2:DescribeInstances networkInterfaces, IPv4/IPv6 addresses; DescribeSecurityGroups; ELBv2 target groups, listeners and load balancers
aws_nist_ec2_instance_not_publicly_acces.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope instance, FAIL if any associated public IPv4/IPv6 address or internet-facing load balancer target has a route and security-group path to a listening port; UNKNOWN on incomplete route, target or ingress inventory.
aws_nist_ec2_instance_not_publicly_acces.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope instance, FAIL if any associated public IPv4/IPv6 address or internet-facing load balancer target has a route and security-group path to a listening port; UNKNOWN on incomplete route, target or ingress inventory.

aws_nist_ecs_task_definition_container_e.description: Arbitrary secret values under neutral names need a maintained secret catalog or manual review of plaintext environment values. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_ecs_task_definition_container_environment_no_secret.
evaluated: ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition containerDefinitions[].environment[].name/value and secrets[].name/valueFrom; approved_secret_values and approved_sensitive_name_patterns policy inputs
aws_nist_ecs_task_definition_container_e.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every task-definition container, FAIL if any plaintext environment value matches approved_secret_values or its name matches an approved sensitive pattern; PASS only with complete environment inventory and supplied secret policy inputs; UNKNOWN otherwise.
aws_nist_ecs_task_definition_container_e.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every task-definition container, FAIL if any plaintext environment value matches approved_secret_values or its name matches an approved sensitive pattern; PASS only with complete environment inventory and supplied secret policy inputs; UNKNOWN otherwise.

aws_nist_efs_access_point_enforce_root_d.description: Checks that each access point has a configured non-root directory; missing, empty and / paths fail. A complete DescribeAccessPoints projection distinguishes an omitted root from an unreadable field; configured root path does not certify mount authorization or isolation.
evaluated: RootDirectory.Path with exact regional account identity
aws_nist_efs_access_point_enforce_root_d.fail_when: The complete native root directory declaration omits Path or sets it to empty or /.
aws_nist_efs_access_point_enforce_root_d.pass_when: The complete native root directory declaration is a canonical absolute path other than the filesystem root.

aws_nist_efs_file_system_in_backup_plan.description: EFS automatic backup policy is not proof of membership in an AWS Backup plan. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_efs_file_system_in_backup_plan.
aws_nist_efs_file_system_in_backup_plan.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each EFS file system, PASS only if an active AWS Backup selection in an active plan includes its ARN directly, via an ARN wildcard, or via matching tag conditions; UNKNOWN on incomplete selection inventory.
aws_nist_efs_file_system_in_backup_plan.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each EFS file system, PASS only if an active AWS Backup selection in an active plan includes its ARN directly, via an ARN wildcard, or via matching tag conditions; UNKNOWN on incomplete selection inventory.

aws_nist_elasticache_redis_cluster_autom.description: Checks the signed ElastiCache Redis cluster automatic backup should be enabled with retention period of 15 days or greater predicate on identity-bound read-only AWS snapshot facts; unavailable detail or unresolved applicability remains UNKNOWN.
evaluated: elasticache:DescribeReplicationGroups SnapshotRetentionLimit and automatic snapshot settings
same-account and same-Region resource inventory and per-field collection coverage
aws_nist_elasticache_redis_cluster_autom.fail_when: A resolved Redis group reports retention below 15, including documented omission on a complete native DescribeReplicationGroups response.
aws_nist_elasticache_redis_cluster_autom.not_applicable_when: A completely resolved group with a known non-Redis engine is outside the signed Redis scope.
aws_nist_elasticache_redis_cluster_autom.pass_when: Every declared cache member resolves to the replication group with Engine redis and retention is an integer at least 15.

aws_nist_elb_application_gateway_network.description: Declared load-balancer zones do not establish registered targets in two zones. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_elb_application_gateway_network_lb_multiple_az_configured.
evaluated: elbv2:DescribeLoadBalancers AvailabilityZones; DescribeTargetGroups/DescribeTargetHealth target AvailabilityZone and Health
aws_nist_elb_application_gateway_network.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each ALB, NLB or GWLB, PASS only if registered healthy instance or IP targets occur in at least two distinct Availability Zones; FAIL if fewer than two; UNKNOWN when target health or zone mapping is incomplete.
aws_nist_elb_application_gateway_network.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each ALB, NLB or GWLB, PASS only if registered healthy instance or IP targets occur in at least two distinct Availability Zones; FAIL if fewer than two; UNKNOWN when target health or zone mapping is incomplete.

aws_nist_emr_cluster_master_nodes_no_pub.description: Subnet auto-assignment policy does not prove an existing master node has no public address. Resolves only current native EMR master instance IDs to same-account EC2 interfaces; it does not infer public exposure from a DNS name or unrelated instances.
evaluated: complete paged ListInstances MASTER/RUNNING and exact primary identity where required
aws_nist_emr_cluster_master_nodes_no_pub.fail_when: A required, identity-bound current master instance has a public IPv4 or global IPv6 address.
aws_nist_emr_cluster_master_nodes_no_pub.not_applicable_when: The EMR cluster is in a recognized state other than running or waiting.
aws_nist_emr_cluster_master_nodes_no_pub.pass_when: Every required current master EC2 instance has complete interface metadata with no public IPv4 or global IPv6 address.

aws_nist_iam_all_policy_no_service_wild_.description: AWS-managed and inline policies remain outside the customer-managed evaluator. Full inventory includes unattached AWS-managed default documents. This is a policy configuration observation; attachments and effective access are evaluated separately.
evaluated: iam_managed_policy: paged ListPolicies Scope=All OnlyAttached=false and GetPolicyVersion default Document
complete account-global IAM inventories, ARN identities and source operation provenance
aws_nist_iam_all_policy_no_service_wild_.fail_when: For every managed or inline policy Allow statement, FAIL if any Action is of the form service:* with Resource=* or another resource pattern granting all of that service; UNKNOWN on incomplete policy inventory.
aws_nist_iam_all_policy_no_service_wild_.pass_when: All required managed defaults and inline documents are readable, identity-bound and parseable; no Allow statement matches the signed service predicate.

aws_nist_iam_policy_no_star_star.description: Inline and AWS-managed policies remain outside the customer-managed evaluator. Full inventory includes unattached AWS-managed default documents. This is a policy configuration observation; attachments and effective access are evaluated separately.
evaluated: iam_managed_policy: paged ListPolicies Scope=All OnlyAttached=false and GetPolicyVersion default Document
complete account-global IAM inventories, ARN identities and source operation provenance
aws_nist_iam_policy_no_star_star.fail_when: For every in-scope managed or inline policy statement with Effect=Allow, FAIL if Action contains * and Resource contains *; expand lists and policy versions, and report UNKNOWN on incomplete policy inventory.
aws_nist_iam_policy_no_star_star.pass_when: All required managed defaults and inline documents are readable, identity-bound and parseable; no Allow statement matches the signed star predicate.

aws_nist_lambda_function_use_latest_runt.description: A supported runtime need not be the approved latest runtime for its language. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_lambda_function_use_latest_runtime.
evaluated: lambda:ListFunctions Runtime, PackageType; required_runtime_by_language approved policy at scan time
aws_nist_lambda_function_use_latest_runt.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each Zip Lambda function, PASS only if Runtime is in the approved latest runtime set for its language at the scan date; UNKNOWN when the approved set is missing or the function uses an image/custom runtime.
aws_nist_lambda_function_use_latest_runt.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each Zip Lambda function, PASS only if Runtime is in the approved latest runtime set for its language at the scan date; UNKNOWN when the approved set is missing or the function uses an image/custom runtime.

aws_nist_opensearch_domain_logs_to_cloud.description: Having publishing options, or destinations only for already enabled types, can leave required logs disabled. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_opensearch_domain_logs_to_cloudwatch.
evaluated: opensearch:DescribeDomain LogPublishingOptions for required log types
aws_nist_opensearch_domain_logs_to_cloud.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every domain, PASS only if every required log type has Enabled=true and a nonempty CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn; UNKNOWN without the required log-type policy.
aws_nist_opensearch_domain_logs_to_cloud.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every domain, PASS only if every required log type has Enabled=true and a nonempty CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn; UNKNOWN without the required log-type policy.

aws_nist_rds_db_cluster_aurora_backtrack.description: A BacktrackWindow of zero disables backtracking yet passes the presence check. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_rds_db_cluster_aurora_backtracking_enabled.
aws_nist_rds_db_cluster_aurora_backtrack.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each Aurora MySQL cluster supporting backtracking, PASS only if BacktrackWindow is an integer >0; FAIL for zero or missing; NOT_APPLICABLE for unsupported engines.
aws_nist_rds_db_cluster_aurora_backtrack.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each Aurora MySQL cluster supporting backtracking, PASS only if BacktrackWindow is an integer >0; FAIL for zero or missing; NOT_APPLICABLE for unsupported engines.

aws_nist_rds_db_instance_and_cluster_enh.description: Checks Enhanced Monitoring on every RDS instance after verifying complete cluster-member identity joins.
evaluated: rds:DescribeDBInstances MonitoringInterval, MonitoringRoleArn, EnhancedMonitoringResourceArn; rds:DescribeDBClusters and member instance identifiers
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_nist_rds_db_instance_and_cluster_enh.fail_when: The instance has a zero interval or lacks either required monitoring ARN.
aws_nist_rds_db_instance_and_cluster_enh.not_applicable_when: No instance subtype exclusion; unresolved cluster membership is UNKNOWN.
aws_nist_rds_db_instance_and_cluster_enh.pass_when: The instance has a positive monitoring interval, monitoring role ARN and monitoring resource ARN.

aws_nist_s3_bucket_cross_region_replicat.description: For each collected S3 source bucket, checks for an enabled replication rule whose destination bucket is confirmed by complete scoped bucket metadata to be in a different AWS Region. It checks declared rule state and destination geography, not object-level replication success.
evaluated: bucket.AccountId and exact source membership in the scoped inventory
context.scope, context.Account, and cached caller identity ARN partition
complete bucket collection scope, account_id, and global marker
complete scoped bucket inventory[].AccountId, Name, and Location.LocationConstraint
aws_nist_s3_bucket_cross_region_replicat.fail_when: The source has a documented absent replication configuration, no enabled rule, or all enabled destinations are proven to be in the source Region.
aws_nist_s3_bucket_cross_region_replicat.pass_when: At least one enabled rule names a collected destination bucket in a Region different from the source bucket.

aws_nist_secretsmanager_secret_automatic.description: RotationRules presence alone does not prove rotation is enabled. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_secretsmanager_secret_automatic_rotation_enabled.
aws_nist_secretsmanager_secret_automatic.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope secret, PASS only if RotationEnabled=true, RotationRules define a valid schedule, and RotationLambdaARN is nonempty where required; FAIL otherwise.
aws_nist_secretsmanager_secret_automatic.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope secret, PASS only if RotationEnabled=true, RotationRules define a valid schedule, and RotationLambdaARN is nonempty where required; FAIL otherwise.

aws_nist_sns_topic_notification_delivery.description: The evaluator checks only a failure-feedback role, not success and failure delivery-status logging. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_sns_topic_notification_delivery_status_enabled.
evaluated: sns:GetTopicAttributes endpoint-specific FailureFeedbackRoleArn, SuccessFeedbackRoleArn and SuccessFeedbackSampleRate
aws_nist_sns_topic_notification_delivery.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each configured SNS delivery protocol, PASS only if failure feedback role is set and success feedback role with positive sample rate is set; UNKNOWN if subscriptions/protocol scope is unavailable.
aws_nist_sns_topic_notification_delivery.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each configured SNS delivery protocol, PASS only if failure feedback role is set and success feedback role with positive sample rate is set; UNKNOWN if subscriptions/protocol scope is unavailable.

aws_nist_vpc_configured_to_use_vpc_endpo.description: The evaluator hard-codes the EC2 endpoint rather than the required service parameter. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_nist_vpc_configured_to_use_vpc_endpoints.
evaluated: ec2:DescribeVpcs and DescribeVpcEndpoints VpcId, ServiceName, State; required_service_name parameter
aws_nist_vpc_configured_to_use_vpc_endpo.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope VPC, PASS only if it has an available endpoint whose ServiceName exactly equals required_service_name; UNKNOWN if that parameter or endpoint inventory is absent.
aws_nist_vpc_configured_to_use_vpc_endpo.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope VPC, PASS only if it has an available endpoint whose ServiceName exactly equals required_service_name; UNKNOWN if that parameter or endpoint inventory is absent.

aws_nist_vpc_igw_attached_to_authorized_.description: Attachment is checked, but authorization against an approved VPC list is not. New Key Vault data-plane GET /keys/{name}/{version}?api-version=7.4 for trusted public JWK; verify signature locally over canonical manifest payload. Collector has no blob-content or manifest collection.
azure.other.signed_log_integrity.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS only if a complete point-in-time versioned listing of every retained log blob matches a manifest entry by name and version, its full-content SHA-256 matches, and the manifest signature verifies under the pinned trusted key/version. FAIL for a known missing, changed, extra or invalidly signed item. UNKNOWN if enumeration, version consistency, key trust, manifest format, bytes or signature algorithm cannot be established.
azure.other.signed_log_integrity.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS only if a complete point-in-time versioned listing of every retained log blob matches a manifest entry by name and version, its full-content SHA-256 matches, and the manifest signature verifies under the pinned trusted key/version. FAIL for a known missing, changed, extra or invalidly signed item. UNKNOWN if enumeration, version consistency, key trust, manifest format, bytes or signature algorithm cannot be established.

azure.other.snapshot_sharing_scope.description: Combines snapshot network export mode with export-capable RBAC assignments. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.snapshot_sharing_scope.
evaluated: ARM GET Microsoft.Compute/snapshots: properties.networkAccessPolicy,publicNetworkAccess,diskAccessId; GET Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/roleDefinitions for snapshot scope; policy input approvedRecipientIds. Include current authorized negative sharing test or equivalent deny evidence for an unauthorized recipient; inventory active SAS grants where available.
azure.other.snapshot_sharing_scope.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each snapshot, FAIL when an unauthorized recipient actually obtains access or a controlled unauthorized grantAccess/sharing attempt succeeds. PASS only when complete effective grant-capable RBAC and outstanding grants are approved and a current authorized negative test or equivalent deny evidence proves unauthorized sharing requests are rejected. UNKNOWN if networkAccessPolicy=AllowAll/publicNetworkAccess=Enabled is merely permissive without proof that an unauthorized principal can grant or receive access, or if network defaults, diskAccess association, inherited RBAC/groups, issued SAS grants, recipient policy, test evidence or pagination is unresolved. No snapshots is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.other.snapshot_sharing_scope.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each snapshot, FAIL when an unauthorized recipient actually obtains access or a controlled unauthorized grantAccess/sharing attempt succeeds. PASS only when complete effective grant-capable RBAC and outstanding grants are approved and a current authorized negative test or equivalent deny evidence proves unauthorized sharing requests are rejected. UNKNOWN if networkAccessPolicy=AllowAll/publicNetworkAccess=Enabled is merely permissive without proof that an unauthorized principal can grant or receive access, or if network defaults, diskAccess association, inherited RBAC/groups, issued SAS grants, recipient policy, test evidence or pagination is unresolved. No snapshots is NOT_APPLICABLE.

azure.other.sshv2_guest_configuration.description: Require SSH protocol 2 on exposed Linux VMs. A finding is raised when the current named SSHv2 baseline reports NonCompliant. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.sshv2_guest_configuration.
evaluated: Per exposed Linux VM: paged Guest Configuration assignment LIST/GET 2024-04-05, properties.latestReportId, then GET {assignmentId}/reports/{latestReportId} and inspect properties.details.resources[] and reasons; approved SSHv2 assignment definition and report freshness policy; complete exposure inventory.
azure.other.sshv2_guest_configuration.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each exposed Linux VM, PASS only if the exact approved SSHv2 assignment has a current completed report whose specific Protocol setting shows SSHv2 or higher and no SSHv1. FAIL only when the current report explicitly proves SSHv1 is allowed. UNKNOWN for missing assignment/report, stale report, ambiguous details, exposure, or incomplete paging. An assignment-level Compliant flag alone is insufficient.
azure.other.sshv2_guest_configuration.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each exposed Linux VM, PASS only if the exact approved SSHv2 assignment has a current completed report whose specific Protocol setting shows SSHv2 or higher and no SSHv1. FAIL only when the current report explicitly proves SSHv1 is allowed. UNKNOWN for missing assignment/report, stale report, ambiguous details, exposure, or incomplete paging. An assignment-level Compliant flag alone is insufficient.

azure.other.storage_geo.description: Checks primary and replicated storage-account regions against an approved EU-region list. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.storage_geo.
evaluated: existing collected storage_account location, sku.name, properties.secondaryLocation; organization-approved EU-region list; authoritative customer-data storage/processing inventory, all applicable service region metadata, and Azure Policy assignments plus compliance results for approved EU locations

FAIL on a fully measured non-EU location or absent/noncompliant restriction policy. UNKNOWN when inventory, region mapping, secondary location, processing location, policy inheritance or compliance result is unresolved. A storage-account-only scan cannot PASS the whole requirement.
azure.other.storage_geo.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each customer-data storage or processing resource in a complete classified inventory, PASS only if every known primary, replica and processing location is within the approved EU region set and an effective region-restriction policy is assigned and compliant at its scope. FAIL on a fully measured non-EU location or absent/noncompliant restriction policy. UNKNOWN when inventory, region mapping, secondary location, processing location, policy inheritance or compliance result is unresolved. A storage-account-only scan cannot PASS the whole requirement.

azure.other.storage_immutability.description: Requires locked time-based immutability for designated audit log containers. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.storage_immutability.
evaluated: Complete inventory of in-scope object and audit-log containers plus required retention policy; ARM container immutabilityPolicies/default GET properties.state and immutabilityPeriodSinceCreationInDays; blob-service version-level immutability and legal-hold settings where used; test/evidence of effective default retention and denied premature delete/modify.
azure.other.storage_immutability.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope object or audit-log container, PASS only if a default retention policy of the required duration is active, the policy cannot be weakened during its term (Locked or equivalent immutable version-level protection), and effective object-level evidence establishes premature delete/modify denial. FAIL on fully measured absent/short/unlocked protection or successful premature change. UNKNOWN if scope, duration, object-level override, inheritance or effective enforcement evidence is missing. A Locked container policy is a configuration signal, not by itself proof for every object.
azure.other.storage_immutability.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope object or audit-log container, PASS only if a default retention policy of the required duration is active, the policy cannot be weakened during its term (Locked or equivalent immutable version-level protection), and effective object-level evidence establishes premature delete/modify denial. FAIL on fully measured absent/short/unlocked protection or successful premature change. UNKNOWN if scope, duration, object-level override, inheritance or effective enforcement evidence is missing. A Locked container policy is a configuration signal, not by itself proof for every object.

azure.other.storage_lifecycle.description: Checks lifecycle deletion rules against minimum retention and maximum deletion age. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.storage_lifecycle.
evaluated: Existing azure.py storage_account.items[]; new managementPolicies/default GET 2023-05-01 per account. properties.policy.rules[].enabled boolean, type=Lifecycle, definition.filters.blobTypes/prefixMatch/blobIndexMatch, definition.actions.baseBlob.delete.daysAfterModificationGreaterThan; policy protected prefixes, minimum retention and maximum deletion days.
azure.other.storage_lifecycle.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every protected blockBlob prefix, PASS only if every applicable enabled delete rule respects minimum retention and at least one rule guarantees deletion by approved maximum. FAIL if an applicable rule can delete earlier or complete policy has no timely deletion. UNKNOWN if overlap, filters, creation/last-access predicates, version/snapshot protection, bounds or policy read cannot be resolved; a broad safe rule cannot mask an earlier overlapping rule.
azure.other.storage_lifecycle.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every protected blockBlob prefix, PASS only if every applicable enabled delete rule respects minimum retention and at least one rule guarantees deletion by approved maximum. FAIL if an applicable rule can delete earlier or complete policy has no timely deletion. UNKNOWN if overlap, filters, creation/last-access predicates, version/snapshot protection, bounds or policy read cannot be resolved; a broad safe rule cannot mask an earlier overlapping rule.

azure.other.vault_key_approved_algorithm.description: Use approved Key Vault key algorithms. A finding is raised when an enabled key version has a disallowed key type, curve or RSA modulus length. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.vault_key_approved_algorithm.
evaluated: Paged Key Vault key names, versions and GET of each enabled version (key.kty, crv, RSA modulus n and key operations), plus import provenance and certified-HSM evidence where the source applies; approved algorithm/size policy.
azure.other.vault_key_approved_algorithm.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope encryption key version, PASS only if its measured algorithm is approved (at least RSA-2048 or approved EC-P256+), current policy confirms it is industry-standard, and imported keys have verified certified-HSM provenance. FAIL on a measured disallowed algorithm/size or disproven required provenance; UNKNOWN for missing key version, algorithm policy, import provenance, HSM certification or incomplete paging. Key material properties alone do not prove import origin.
azure.other.vault_key_approved_algorithm.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope encryption key version, PASS only if its measured algorithm is approved (at least RSA-2048 or approved EC-P256+), current policy confirms it is industry-standard, and imported keys have verified certified-HSM provenance. FAIL on a measured disallowed algorithm/size or disproven required provenance; UNKNOWN for missing key version, algorithm policy, import provenance, HSM certification or incomplete paging. Key material properties alone do not prove import origin.

azure.other.vault_old_secret_disabled.description: Checks disabled state of old Key Vault secret versions after rotation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.vault_old_secret_disabled.
evaluated: Paged Key Vault data-plane /secrets?api-version=7.4 and /secrets/{name}/versions?api-version=7.4: attributes.enabled boolean, created integer Unix seconds, id/version; approvedRotationDays and UTC clock; version ordering and current version resolved by version ID. Current authorized negative read test or equivalent Key Vault authorization evidence for each applicable superseded version is required for the frozen denial claim.
azure.other.vault_old_secret_disabled.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every secret, FAIL if a controlled read of a superseded version past approvedRotationDays succeeds, or if authoritative effective access evidence proves it remains readable. PASS only if complete name/version pages and ordering identify every outdated superseded version and current authorized negative tests or equivalent effective-denial evidence prove access is denied for each. UNKNOWN for missing rotation policy, creation time, version identity, incomplete paging or unmeasured effective denial. attributes.enabled=false is a useful configuration signal but alone does not prove the frozen access-denial requirement.
azure.other.vault_old_secret_disabled.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every secret, FAIL if a controlled read of a superseded version past approvedRotationDays succeeds, or if authoritative effective access evidence proves it remains readable. PASS only if complete name/version pages and ordering identify every outdated superseded version and current authorized negative tests or equivalent effective-denial evidence prove access is denied for each. UNKNOWN for missing rotation policy, creation time, version identity, incomplete paging or unmeasured effective denial. attributes.enabled=false is a useful configuration signal but alone does not prove the frozen access-denial requirement.

azure.other.vnet_peering_allowlist.description: Restricts active VNet peering targets to an approved ARM resource ID list. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: azure.other.vnet_peering_allowlist.
evaluated: ARM virtualNetworkPeerings LIST 2023-09-01 under each VNet with nextLink paging, properties.remoteVirtualNetwork.id and peeringState; approvedPeerIds policy and Azure Policy deny/controlled request-time test for prevention evidence.
azure.other.vnet_peering_allowlist.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every configured peering returned by complete child peering LIST pages, compare properties.remoteVirtualNetwork.id with approved peer ARM IDs. PASS for the frozen request-time prevention rule only when an enforced deny policy or controlled rejected request proves unapproved peering requests are blocked and complete current configuration has no unapproved peerings. UNKNOWN for missing remote ID, policy, deny enforcement or pages; current configuration alone is PARTIAL.
azure.other.vnet_peering_allowlist.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every configured peering returned by complete child peering LIST pages, compare properties.remoteVirtualNetwork.id with approved peer ARM IDs. FAIL for a configured unapproved target or a successful controlled request to an unapproved peer.
