evaluated: Explicit native Cloud Storage project/bucket/object/generation targets; generation-bound complete UTF-8 text via storage.objects.get metadata and streamed media
native subject/project authority and complete bounded stream
redacted exact-value fingerprint and source locations
gcp.review.storage.selected_object_secre.fail_when: A likely secret is detected in the completely scanned selected content; its value is hidden and credential validity is not tested.
gcp.review.storage.selected_object_secre.not_applicable_when: Only explicitly selected content is evaluated; missing or unreadable selected content remains UNKNOWN.
gcp.review.storage.selected_object_secre.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete without a supported match in this explicitly selected supported content.

gcp.review.workbench.auto_upgrade_schedu.description: Checks the Workbench v2 upgrade-schedule metadata declaration against a bounded supported cron format. A schedule does not establish upgrade execution, cadence adequacy or current patch status.
gcp.review.workbench.auto_upgrade_schedu.fail_when: The schedule is absent in a full native representation or is explicitly empty.
gcp.review.workbench.auto_upgrade_schedu.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
gcp.review.workbench.auto_upgrade_schedu.pass_when: A supported nonempty five-field cron schedule is declared.

gcp.review.workbench.file_download_disab.description: Checks whether Workbench v2 metadata disables downloads through JupyterLab. Other data-transfer paths and effective data-loss prevention are outside this configuration check.
gcp.review.workbench.file_download_disab.fail_when: The metadata key is false or absent in a full native representation.
gcp.review.workbench.file_download_disab.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
gcp.review.workbench.file_download_disab.pass_when: The exact metadata key is the documented string true.

gcp.review.workbench.public_ip_disabled.description: Checks whether public IP assignment is disabled; it does not test a reachable network path.
evaluated: complete native representation for omitted defaults
gcp.review.workbench.public_ip_disabled.fail_when: The setting enables the feature, including its documented default in a full native representation.
gcp.review.workbench.public_ip_disabled.pass_when: The setting explicitly disables the feature.

gcp.review.workbench.root_access_disable.description: Checks the notebook root-access metadata setting; it does not execute commands as root.
evaluated: complete native representation for omitted defaults
gcp.review.workbench.root_access_disable.fail_when: The setting enables the feature, including its documented default in a full native representation.
gcp.review.workbench.root_access_disable.pass_when: The setting explicitly disables the feature.

gcp.review.workbench.selected_referenced.description: Scans the selected current startup or post-startup GCS script referenced by the owned Workbench instance. Instance identity, reference and current object generation must agree before and after the read. Cached or previously executed bytes are not established.
evaluated: Exact current Workbench v2 instance ID and selected supported metadata GCS reference
Owned project/bucket and coherent current object generation surrounding pinned source read
gcp.review.workbench.selected_referenced.fail_when: A supported credential-like literal is detected in the coherently bound captured source.
gcp.review.workbench.selected_referenced.not_applicable_when: No applicable source was selected; missing, denied, unsupported or incomplete selected sources remain UNKNOWN.
gcp.review.workbench.selected_referenced.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete without detecting a supported secret in the selected captured source.

gcp.review.workbench.terminal_access_dis.description: Checks whether Workbench v2 metadata disables the JupyterLab terminal. Notebook code execution and effective operating-system isolation are outside this configuration check.
gcp.review.workbench.terminal_access_dis.fail_when: The metadata key is false or absent in a full native representation.
gcp.review.workbench.terminal_access_dis.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
gcp.review.workbench.terminal_access_dis.pass_when: The exact metadata key is the documented string true.

gcp.review.workbench_instance.literal_co.description: Uses offline Kingfisher and TruffleHog to inspect only the explicitly selected supported content: Native Workbench v2 returned GCE metadata literals including inline scripts. It retains redacted fingerprints and locations, never raw values; a negative is limited to inspected content.
evaluated: Native Workbench v2 metadata and systemMetadata string maps including inline scripts
native subject/project authority and complete bounded stream
redacted exact-value fingerprint and source locations
gcp.review.workbench_instance.literal_co.fail_when: A likely secret is detected in the completely scanned selected content; its value is hidden and credential validity is not tested.
gcp.review.workbench_instance.literal_co.not_applicable_when: Only explicitly selected content is evaluated; missing or unreadable selected content remains UNKNOWN.
gcp.review.workbench_instance.literal_co.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete without a supported match in this explicitly selected supported content.

gcp.review.workflow.deployed_source_secr.description: Uses offline Kingfisher and TruffleHog to inspect only the explicitly selected supported content: Native deployed Workflows sourceContents bound to its returned name and discovered revisionId, retrieved with read-only revision-specific GET. It retains redacted fingerprints and locations, never raw values; a negative is limited to inspected content.
evaluated: Native deployed Workflows sourceContents bound to its returned name and discovered revisionId, retrieved with read-only revision-specific GET
native subject/project authority and complete bounded stream
redacted exact-value fingerprint and source locations
gcp.review.workflow.deployed_source_secr.fail_when: A likely secret is detected in the completely scanned selected content; its value is hidden and credential validity is not tested.
gcp.review.workflow.deployed_source_secr.not_applicable_when: Only explicitly selected content is evaluated; missing or unreadable selected content remains UNKNOWN.
gcp.review.workflow.deployed_source_secr.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete without a supported match in this explicitly selected supported content.

gcp.sql.deletion_protection.description: On each Cloud SQL instance in a complete project inventory, checks the observed settings.deletionProtectionEnabled Boolean. True passes and explicit false fails; missing, denied, malformed, or incomplete instance data remains unknown.
gcp.sql.deletion_protection.fail_when: The complete collected instance explicitly declares settings.deletionProtectionEnabled=false.
gcp.sql.deletion_protection.pass_when: The complete collected instance explicitly declares settings.deletionProtectionEnabled=true.

gcp.sql.iam_database_authentication.description: Checks Cloud SQL engine and complete instance-bound usersList.items type/name. A supported instance has no IAM user type in its complete users list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
evaluated: Cloud SQL engine and complete instance-bound usersList.items type/name
gcp.sql.iam_database_authentication.fail_when: A supported instance has no IAM user type in its complete users list.
gcp.sql.iam_database_authentication.pass_when: A supported instance has an IAM user type.

gcp.sql.mysql_admin_account_posture.description: Joins the composite, percent-encoded SQL user identity to a complete same-project sql_instance inventory and checks recognized engine, userName, host and user type. For MySQL, root or BUILT_IN with host % or 0.0.0.0/0 fails; every other well-formed tuple passes. Invalid user enums, mismatched identity fields or an unresolved parent return UNKNOWN. Other recognized engines are not applicable. This checks declared login host metadata, not effective network reachability.
gcp.sql.mysql_admin_account_posture.fail_when: A MySQL user has (userName=root or type=BUILT_IN) and host % or 0.0.0.0/0.
gcp.sql.mysql_admin_account_posture.not_applicable_when: The exact parent instance has a recognized PostgreSQL or SQL Server databaseVersion.
gcp.sql.mysql_admin_account_posture.pass_when: A MySQL user does not combine root or BUILT_IN identity with host % or 0.0.0.0/0.

gcp_api_keys_active_services_only.description: Checks an active API Keys v2 key from a complete project keys.list inventory for declared restrictions.apiTargets service strings. Any exact cloudapis.googleapis.com target is UNKNOWN. The collector requests deleteTime and restrictions explicitly; missing, denied, partial, malformed, duplicate or detached required inventory/provenance facts remain UNKNOWN. PASS proves target presence only: service-name validity, service existence or activation, approval, client restrictions, and key-string exposure are unproven. Native category hardening normalizes the signed source category identity without changing the signed criterion.
evaluated: complete project-scoped api_key inventory from paginated keys.list
gcp_api_keys_active_services_only.fail_when: The active key has absent or empty restrictions.apiTargets in the complete projected keys.list response.
gcp_api_keys_active_services_only.not_applicable_when: The key matches its verified complete project inventory and has a nonempty deleteTime that parses as a timezone-aware timestamp; malformed deletion evidence is UNKNOWN.
gcp_api_keys_active_services_only.pass_when: The active key matches its verified complete project inventory, declares at least one API target, every target service is a nonblank string, and none equals cloudapis.googleapis.com. This proves declared target presence only.

gcp_artifact_registry_cleanup_policy.description: Checks for at least one DELETE cleanup policy with olderThan at or below max_artifact_age and cleanupPolicyDryRun=false. On a full representation, omitted dry-run means false and omitted cleanupPolicies means no policies. Valid DELETE conditions without olderThan do not qualify; malformed policy actions, unions, durations or known selectors return UNKNOWN. This existential declaration check does not prove that KEEP rules or other condition filters permit deletion of every old artifact.
evaluated: artifact_repository.cleanupPolicies map action and condition.olderThan Duration
gcp_artifact_registry_cleanup_policy.fail_when: Dry run is true or no policy qualifies in the complete policy map.
gcp_artifact_registry_cleanup_policy.pass_when: Dry run is false and at least one valid DELETE policy has olderThan at or below the configured maximum.

gcp_autoscaler_capacity_target.description: Checks Autoscaler CPU target/max replicas and joined target MIG targetSize. CPU target exceeds 0.8 or max replicas do not exceed target size. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
evaluated: Autoscaler CPU target/max replicas and joined target MIG targetSize
gcp_autoscaler_capacity_target.fail_when: CPU target exceeds 0.8 or max replicas do not exceed target size.
gcp_autoscaler_capacity_target.pass_when: CPU target is at most 0.8 and max replicas exceed current target size.

gcp_backend_service_checks_armor_securit.description: Checks applicable, attached Cloud Armor policies for a non-default rule with a nonempty match. Incomplete global or regional policy inventory and malformed rules remain UNKNOWN.
gcp_backend_service_checks_armor_securit.fail_when: An attached policy has no rule before priority 2147483647 with a nonempty match.
gcp_backend_service_checks_armor_securit.pass_when: An attached policy has at least one such non-default rule.

gcp_bucket_logging_enabled_fb7cc594582a.description: For a complete full-projection Cloud Storage bucket, checks that logging.logBucket names a usage/storage-log destination bucket. This checks the bucket logging declaration; it does not prove timely or complete log delivery and does not assess Cloud Audit Logs.
evaluated: bucket.logging.logBucket (documented omission means unset in FULL projection)
gcp_bucket_logging_enabled_fb7cc594582a.fail_when: A full bucket resource omits logging or logging.logBucket, or declares an empty logBucket.
gcp_bucket_logging_enabled_fb7cc594582a.pass_when: A full bucket resource declares a nonempty logging.logBucket.

gcp_c5_access_approval.description: On access approval settings resources, detects when an in-scope provider access event requiring customer consent has no matching approved request that precedes access; this matters because it can lead to account takeover or privilege misuse. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_access_approval.
evaluated: Access Approval approvalRequests.list: name, requestTime, requestedExpiration, requestedLocations, approve.decisionTime; Cloud Logging entries.list: timestamp, serviceName, principal, resourceName; approved customer-consent scope.
gcp_c5_access_approval.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope Cloud Logging provider-access entry timestamp has no Access Approval approvalRequests.list item with matching resource/service scope, approve.decisionTime <= entry.timestamp and requestedExpiration > entry.timestamp; UNKNOWN when applicability or log coverage is incomplete.
gcp_c5_access_approval.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope Cloud Logging provider-access entry timestamp has no Access Approval approvalRequests.list item with matching resource/service scope, approve.decisionTime <= entry.timestamp and requestedExpiration > entry.timestamp; UNKNOWN when applicability or log coverage is incomplete.

gcp_c5_asset_change_audit.description: On asset resources, detects when an in-scope asset creation, update, or deletion seen across two snapshots has no matching retained Admin Activity event in the approved window; this matters because it can lead to loss of audit evidence. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_asset_change_audit.
evaluated: Cloud Asset Inventory assets.list contentType=RESOURCE readTime: name, assetType, updateTime; Cloud Logging entries.list: timestamp, protoPayload.methodName, protoPayload.resourceName and operation result.
gcp_c5_asset_change_audit.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when two complete CAI snapshots differ for an asset name/updateTime and no Cloud Logging entries.list event with matching protoPayload.resourceName and Admin Activity method exists within the approved time window; UNKNOWN when snapshots or logs are incomplete.
gcp_c5_asset_change_audit.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when two complete CAI snapshots differ for an asset name/updateTime and no Cloud Logging entries.list event with matching protoPayload.resourceName and Admin Activity method exists within the approved time window; UNKNOWN when snapshots or logs are incomplete.

gcp_c5_asset_inventory.description: On asset resources, detects when a complete CAI query omits a resource independently present in a complete service inventory or required asset metadata (name, assetType, updateTime) is absent; this matters because it can lead to incomplete ownership and risk inventory. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_asset_inventory.
evaluated: Cloud Asset Inventory projects.assets.list contentType=RESOURCE: name, assetType, updateTime; independent service inventory resource names and approved in-scope assetTypes.
gcp_c5_asset_inventory.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every approved in-scope asset type, FAIL if a complete CAI query omits a resource independently present in a complete service inventory or required asset metadata (name, assetType, updateTime) is absent; UNKNOWN when either inventory is incomplete. A separate approved asset scope is required.
gcp_c5_asset_inventory.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every approved in-scope asset type, FAIL if a complete CAI query omits a resource independently present in a complete service inventory or required asset metadata (name, assetType, updateTime) is absent; UNKNOWN when either inventory is incomplete. A separate approved asset scope is required.

gcp_c5_asset_risk_label.description: Checks only approved label-capable CAI asset types against a project-bound risk label schema. Missing resource.data.labels, unavailable scope or malformed labels remain UNKNOWN.
gcp_c5_asset_risk_label.fail_when: An in-scope asset has no required label or its value is outside approved_risk_values.
gcp_c5_asset_risk_label.pass_when: The required risk label has an approved value.

gcp_c5_backup_remote_location.description: On sql instance resources, detects when a fully inventoried in-scope backup target has the same failure region as its source contrary to the approved offsite policy; this matters because it can lead to unrecoverable data loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_backup_remote_location.
evaluated: Existing Cloud SQL instances.get replicaNames/region and Cloud Storage buckets.list location plus Transfer Service transferJobs.list destination metadata.
gcp_c5_backup_remote_location.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope backup target region equals its source sql_instance.region or bucket.location and approved_offsite_policy requires a different failure region; UNKNOWN when the backup target cannot be joined.
gcp_c5_backup_remote_location.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope backup target region equals its source sql_instance.region or bucket.location and approved_offsite_policy requires a different failure region; UNKNOWN when the backup target cannot be joined.

gcp_c5_build_provenance.description: On cloudbuild trigger resources, detects when an in-scope production deployment build has no immutable source revision or successful completed build record; this matters because it can lead to untrusted production changes. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_build_provenance.
evaluated: Cloud Build builds.list/get: triggerId, status, createTime, sourceProvenance.resolvedRepoSource.commitSha, substitutions.COMMIT_SHA; approved production deployment scope.
gcp_c5_build_provenance.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope Cloud Build build has status!=SUCCESS or sourceProvenance.resolvedRepoSource.commitSha and substitutions.COMMIT_SHA are both empty; UNKNOWN for production deployments outside Cloud Build.
gcp_c5_build_provenance.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope Cloud Build build has status!=SUCCESS or sourceProvenance.resolvedRepoSource.commitSha and substitutions.COMMIT_SHA are both empty; UNKNOWN for production deployments outside Cloud Build.

gcp_c5_classification_label.description: Checks an explicitly in-scope Cloud Storage bucket against the required classification label key and approved values. A missing label on a proven full projection is absent. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing policy or labels in a partial projection returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_c5_classification_label.fail_when: The required label is absent on a full bucket projection or has an unapproved value.
gcp_c5_classification_label.not_applicable_when: The bucket is outside the explicit classified_buckets set.
gcp_c5_classification_label.pass_when: The required classification label has an approved value.

gcp_c5_cloud_armor_waf.description: Checks an explicitly approved, topology-verified internet-reachable admin backend against complete Cloud Armor rules. Missing admin mapping, route inventories, rule details or approved expression/action remain UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete backend_service, security_policy, url_map, target_https_proxy and forwarding_rule inventories
security policy rules priority, disabled, match expression and action
gcp_c5_cloud_armor_waf.fail_when: An in-scope public admin backend has no attached policy or the attached policy lacks the approved enabled WAF rule.
gcp_c5_cloud_armor_waf.not_applicable_when: The approved mapping marks the backend outside public admin scope.
gcp_c5_cloud_armor_waf.pass_when: The attached policy has an enabled rule with the exact approved expression and action.

gcp_c5_cloudbuild_gate.description: Checks approved production triggers for required approval and the named security-test step in a collected build definition. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope. UNKNOWN for file-backed definitions whose steps have not been read. UNKNOWN when production deployments outside Cloud Build are unresolved.
gcp_c5_cloudbuild_gate.fail_when: Required approval is false or the collected build definition lacks the required security-test step.
gcp_c5_cloudbuild_gate.not_applicable_when: The trigger is outside the approved production trigger set.
gcp_c5_cloudbuild_gate.pass_when: The production trigger satisfies required approval and includes the required security-test step.

gcp_c5_deletion_recoverability.description: Requires a complete, same-project snapshot collection and valid native identities; incomplete, malformed, missing, or foreign-scope facts yield UNKNOWN. After an approved immediate-deletion deadline, checks only bucket-level recovery settings. Object-level deletion, sanitization, and other storage products are outside this evidence. Missing policy, timing, or recovery fields yield UNKNOWN.
gcp_c5_deletion_recoverability.fail_when: After the approved immediate-deletion deadline, soft-delete retention or retention-policy period is positive, or versioning is enabled.
gcp_c5_deletion_recoverability.not_applicable_when: No approved immediate-deletion rule applies, or its deadline has not passed.
gcp_c5_deletion_recoverability.pass_when: The approved immediate-deletion deadline has passed and all three recovery settings are zero or disabled.

gcp_c5_iam_change_timeliness.description: On iam policy resources, detects when an in-scope principal retains a grant beyond the required 48-hour or 14-day deadline after a supplied role-change event; this matters because it can lead to account takeover or privilege misuse. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: complete scoped/inherited IAM bindings, complete approved personnel-change feed and snapshot time
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_iam_change_timeliness.fail_when: An event principal still holds its forbidden role after the applicable deadline.
gcp_c5_iam_change_timeliness.pass_when: No forbidden retained grant is past its 48-hour privileged or 14-day other deadline.

gcp_c5_iam_conditions.description: On iam policy resources, detects when an in-scope contextual grant requires attributes but its IAM binding has no approved condition expression for the required time/resource/principal attributes; this matters because it can lead to account takeover or privilege misuse. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: complete scoped/inherited IAM bindings and approved required attribute references by grant
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_iam_conditions.fail_when: A required grant has no condition expression or omits an approved required reference.
gcp_c5_iam_conditions.pass_when: Every required grant condition expression contains all approved required references.

gcp_c5_iam_expiry.description: On iam policy resources, detects when for an in-scope privileged role binding with no enforceable request.time expiry condition when time limitation is required by the approved policy; this matters because it can lead to account takeover or privilege misuse. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: complete scoped/inherited IAM bindings and approved list of privileged grants requiring expiry
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_iam_expiry.fail_when: A listed privileged grant has no enforceable request.time expiry expression.
gcp_c5_iam_expiry.pass_when: Every listed privileged grant has a request.time expiry expression.

gcp_c5_iam_inventory.description: Compares resource-role-principal tuples on Cloud Asset IAM search results with an explicit project-bound approved roster. Requires a complete same-project iam_policy inventory, successful exact-scope GET searchAllIamPolicies request evidence linked to the envelope and evaluated item, and unique well-formed roster tuples with boolean approvals. Root-policy-only and non-search facts, contradictory roster approvals and missing provenance return UNKNOWN. Conditions are preserved in facts but are not evaluated for effective permissions.
evaluated: metadata.source_requests GET searchAllIamPolicies; envelope and item source_requests
gcp_c5_iam_inventory.fail_when: An observed tuple on this search result is unapproved or absent from the roster.
gcp_c5_iam_inventory.pass_when: Every observed tuple on this search result is approved in the roster.

gcp_c5_key_versions.description: Checks each version in a complete KMS version inventory against its own project-bound enabled expiry and destruction schedule at snapshot time. Missing per-version dates, versions or timestamps remain UNKNOWN.
evaluated: version name, state and destroyTime for destroyed versions
gcp_c5_key_versions.fail_when: An ENABLED version remains after approved expiry or a DESTROYED version was destroyed before the approved date.
gcp_c5_key_versions.pass_when: Every version is within the supplied lifecycle schedule.

gcp_c5_kms_hsm.description: Checks an explicitly designated Cloud KMS key primary protection level against HSM, with EXTERNAL_VPC accepted only for an explicitly approved key. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing designation policy or primary metadata returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_c5_kms_hsm.fail_when: The designated key primary has another recognized protection level.
gcp_c5_kms_hsm.not_applicable_when: The key is outside the designated HSM key set.
gcp_c5_kms_hsm.pass_when: The designated key primary is HSM, or approved EXTERNAL_VPC.

gcp_c5_log_event_fields.description: On an audit log entry, detects a missing or invalid timestamp or authenticated principalEmail; this prevents reliable attribution and timeline reconstruction. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_log_event_fields.
evaluated: Cloud Logging entries.list: timestamp, resource.type, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and protoPayload.methodName.
gcp_c5_log_event_fields.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope entries.list item has invalid timestamp or an authenticated protoPayload.methodName has empty protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail; UNKNOWN for exempt/system events.
gcp_c5_log_event_fields.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope entries.list item has invalid timestamp or an authenticated protoPayload.methodName has empty protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail; UNKNOWN for exempt/system events.

gcp_c5_log_export.description: Evaluates complete project and ancestor sink routes for the approved customer destination and required audit method classes. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_c5_log_export.fail_when: At least one required class reaches no enabled approved customer destination.
gcp_c5_log_export.pass_when: Each required log class reaches at least one enabled approved customer destination.

gcp_c5_log_isolation.description: Checks enabled sink destinations against the approved complete customer-data bucket register and explicit sink/bucket exceptions. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope. UNKNOWN when an external sink destination cannot be classified.
evaluated: complete project and ancestor sink inventory
gcp_c5_log_isolation.fail_when: An enabled sink exports to a registered customer-data bucket without an exception.
gcp_c5_log_isolation.pass_when: Every enabled in-scope sink has a recognized storage-bucket destination outside the register or an approved exception.

gcp_c5_log_retention.description: Requires a complete, same-project snapshot collection and valid native identities; incomplete, malformed, missing, or foreign-scope facts yield UNKNOWN. Checks a projected in-scope Cloud Logging bucket against approved retention bounds and lock requirement. External destinations, missing policy, and incomplete bucket fields remain UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete scoped bucket projection of projects.locations.buckets.list with unique name and _provenance.scope
gcp_c5_log_retention.fail_when: Retention is below the approved minimum, exceeds the maximum after the deletion deadline, or the required lock is disabled.
gcp_c5_log_retention.pass_when: Retention meets the approved minimum, is no greater than the maximum once the deletion deadline has passed, and the required lock is enabled.

gcp_c5_logging_redundancy.description: Counts distinct enabled sink destination values covering every critical log method class when two destinations are required. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope. UNKNOWN when destination independence is unverified.
gcp_c5_logging_redundancy.fail_when: At least one critical class has fewer than two such destinations.
gcp_c5_logging_redundancy.not_applicable_when: The approved architecture does not require two destinations.
gcp_c5_logging_redundancy.pass_when: Every critical class is covered by at least two distinct enabled destination values with an approved independence pair.

gcp_c5_malware_telemetry.description: On instance resources, detects when an in-scope VM required to run an approved protection agent has a complete current package inventory showing the agent absent; this matters because it can lead to undetected malicious software. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: current complete package inventory and an approved required agent name for the VM
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_malware_telemetry.fail_when: The required agent package name is absent from current complete inventory.
gcp_c5_malware_telemetry.not_applicable_when: The VM has no approved agent requirement.
gcp_c5_malware_telemetry.pass_when: The required agent package name appears in current inventory.

gcp_c5_network_separation.description: For a VPC listed in segregated_vpcs, checks complete same-project instance facts and each attached interface with matching network. Production and nonproduction sharing a declared subnetwork fails; otherwise passes. Empty VM interface inventories, missing subnetwork identities or unclassified connected VMs return UNKNOWN. Other VPCs are not applicable. This checks logical subnet declarations only, not isolation enforcement or physical separation.
evaluated: Complete same-scope network and instance inventories, VM labels.env and networkInterfaces.network/subnetwork, scoped segregated_vpcs policy
gcp_c5_network_separation.fail_when: For this in-scope VPC, a production and nonproduction VM interface share a subnetwork.
gcp_c5_network_separation.not_applicable_when: The VPC is outside the approved segregation scope.
gcp_c5_network_separation.pass_when: For this in-scope VPC, no production and nonproduction VM interface shares a subnetwork.

gcp_c5_network_topology.description: Checks all entries in the project-bound topology register against complete same-project network, subnetwork and firewall inventories. A missing registered asset or a declared network/region mismatch fails; all matching entries pass. Register kind/name and required network/region fields are validated before absence can produce FAIL. Missing, empty or malformed registers and unresolved inventory completeness return UNKNOWN. The verdict covers the whole project register and can repeat for each network; unregistered assets are not evaluated.
evaluated: Complete same-scope network, subnetwork and firewall inventories, and topology_register kind/name/network/region
gcp_c5_network_topology.fail_when: A registered asset is absent or its network or region differs from the register.
gcp_c5_network_topology.pass_when: Every register entry exists and its network and region relationships agree with current metadata.

gcp_c5_patch_deployment.description: On instance resources, detects when an in-scope supported VM has no applicable enabled recurring patch deployment or its package inventory exceeds the approved patch age; this matters because it can lead to unpatched exploitable software. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_patch_deployment.
evaluated: OS Config patchDeployments.list: name, instanceFilter, recurringSchedule, patchConfig; inventories.get: updateTime, items.installedPackages; approved patch age by package.
gcp_c5_patch_deployment.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope VM matches no enabled patchDeployments.list instanceFilter with recurringSchedule, or its inventories.get items.installedPackages age exceeds approved_patch_age; UNKNOWN when schedule, age policy or inventory is unavailable.
gcp_c5_patch_deployment.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope VM matches no enabled patchDeployments.list instanceFilter with recurringSchedule, or its inventories.get items.installedPackages age exceeds approved_patch_age; UNKNOWN when schedule, age policy or inventory is unavailable.

gcp_c5_region.description: Joins an approved asset-to-service mapping with complete service inventory and resolves its location to regions using explicit policy. Unknown multi-region mappings and missing service evidence remain UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete asset and mapped service inventory
bucket.location, sql_instance.region, gke_cluster.location or kms_key.name location
gcp_c5_region.fail_when: A mapped in-scope resource resolves to at least one region outside its approved set.
gcp_c5_region.not_applicable_when: No approved residency scope names the asset.
gcp_c5_region.pass_when: All resolved regions for the mapped resource are approved.

gcp_c5_restore_destination.description: On sql instance resources, detects when a successful Cloud SQL RESTORE_VOLUME or CLONE targets an instance not in the approved restoration-instance set, or if target settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled=true while source is false, or target IAM adds allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers absent on source; this matters because it can lead to unrecoverable data loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_restore_destination.
evaluated: Cloud SQL Admin operations.list: operationType, targetId, status; instances.get: name, settings.ipConfiguration, region; Cloud Asset Inventory searchAllIamPolicies bindings for source and target.
gcp_c5_restore_destination.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a successful Cloud SQL RESTORE_VOLUME or CLONE targets an instance not in the approved restoration-instance set, or if target settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled=true while source is false, or target IAM adds allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers absent on source; UNKNOWN without source-target correlation or complete IAM policy.
gcp_c5_restore_destination.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a successful Cloud SQL RESTORE_VOLUME or CLONE targets an instance not in the approved restoration-instance set, or if target settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled=true while source is false, or target IAM adds allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers absent on source; UNKNOWN without source-target correlation or complete IAM policy.

gcp_c5_restore_test.description: On sql instance resources, detects when an approved annual test scope has complete event coverage and no successful restore or clone test event in 365 days; this matters because it can lead to unrecoverable data loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_restore_test.
evaluated: Cloud SQL Admin operations.list: operationType, status, endTime, targetId, error; approved SQL restore-test scope and 365-day interval.
gcp_c5_restore_test.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when operations.list contains no operation with operationType in {RESTORE_VOLUME,CLONE}, status=DONE, error absent and endTime within 365 days for an approved SQL test target; UNKNOWN when operation coverage or validation result is unavailable.
gcp_c5_restore_test.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when operations.list contains no operation with operationType in {RESTORE_VOLUME,CLONE}, status=DONE, error absent and endTime within 365 days for an approved SQL test target; UNKNOWN when operation coverage or validation result is unavailable.

gcp_c5_sbom.description: On artifact repository resources, detects when a completely inventoried in-scope deployed image digest has no associated SBOM occurrence; this matters because it can lead to untrusted production changes. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_c5_sbom.
evaluated: Artifact Registry dockerImages.list: uri, tags; Artifact Analysis occurrences.list: resourceUri, kind=SBOM_REFERENCE, noteName; approved deployed image digest inventory.
Complete inventories: artifact_repository, artifact_image, sbom_occurrence, deployed_image
gcp_c5_sbom.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope deployed image digest from dockerImages.list has no occurrences.list item with matching resourceUri and kind=SBOM_REFERENCE; UNKNOWN when deployment digest mapping or occurrence inventory is incomplete.
gcp_c5_sbom.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope deployed image digest from dockerImages.list has no occurrences.list item with matching resourceUri and kind=SBOM_REFERENCE; UNKNOWN when deployment digest mapping or occurrence inventory is incomplete.

gcp_c5_secret_access.description: Credential-classified secrets are checked against direct and inherited secret payload-reader grants and an approved reader roster. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.
gcp_c5_secret_access.fail_when: A payload-reader binding includes a public or unapproved principal.
gcp_c5_secret_access.not_applicable_when: Secret is not classified as a credential.
gcp_c5_secret_access.pass_when: No public or unapproved payload-reader member is present.

gcp_c5_security_event_route.description: Operator-approved log metrics are checked against complete Logging metrics, enabled alert policies and enabled notification channels. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.
gcp_c5_security_event_route.fail_when: A required metric is absent from the complete Logging inventory or has no enabled policy with an enabled notification channel.
gcp_c5_security_event_route.pass_when: Each required metric is referenced by an enabled policy with an enabled channel.

gcp_c5_siem_sink.description: Evaluates project and ancestor sink routes to the approved SIEM destination for every required audit method class. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_c5_siem_sink.fail_when: At least one required class has no such route.
gcp_c5_siem_sink.pass_when: Every required class reaches an enabled sink to the approved SIEM destination.

gcp_c5_software_inventory.description: On instance resources, detects when a completely collected in-scope VM lacks an approved software inventory record or an installed package is absent from the required software register; this matters because it can lead to incomplete ownership and risk inventory. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: complete OS inventory, current updateTime, installed package names/versions and approved software register
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_software_inventory.fail_when: No current inventory record exists in complete coverage or an installed name/version is unregistered.
gcp_c5_software_inventory.not_applicable_when: The VM is outside approved VM scope.
gcp_c5_software_inventory.pass_when: A current inventory record exists and every installed name/version is registered.

gcp_c5_sql_backup_run.description: On a primary Cloud SQL instance, detects disabled automated backups or no successful backup run within the approved RPO; this raises the amount of data that can be lost. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: primary SQL instance backup setting, complete automated backup-run inventory and approved RPO
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_c5_sql_backup_run.fail_when: Automated backups are disabled or no successful automated run ended within the approved RPO.
gcp_c5_sql_backup_run.not_applicable_when: The SQL instance is outside approved SQL scope or is not a primary instance.
gcp_c5_sql_backup_run.pass_when: Automated backups are enabled and a SUCCESSFUL automated run ended within the approved RPO.

gcp_c5_tls_policy.description: Resolves a target proxy sslPolicy against the complete same-project SSL policy inventory. A CUSTOM policy must have a recognized minimum TLS version and nonempty customFeatures, compared with explicit approved bounds. Below-bound TLS or any unapproved feature fails. Empty features, built-in profile expansion, missing policy or malformed bounds return UNKNOWN. Runtime TLS negotiation is not tested.
evaluated: Target proxy sslPolicy, joined CUSTOM SSL policy minimum TLS/customFeatures, approved bounds
gcp_c5_tls_policy.fail_when: CUSTOM policy minimum TLS is below the bound or has an unapproved custom cipher.
gcp_c5_tls_policy.pass_when: CUSTOM policy minimum TLS and every custom cipher satisfy approved bounds.

gcp_c5_workforce_federation.description: Checks mapped customer workforce pools and providers for ACTIVE state and approved OIDC issuer/audiences. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_c5_workforce_federation.fail_when: The mapped pool or provider is not ACTIVE, or its issuer/audiences violate the approved mapping.
gcp_c5_workforce_federation.not_applicable_when: The pool is outside the approved customer mapping.
gcp_c5_workforce_federation.pass_when: The mapped pool and provider are ACTIVE, and the provider issuer and nonempty audiences match the approved mapping.

gcp_certificate_renewal_30_days.description: Compares deployed certificate expiry and replacement activation against the scan timestamp and 24-hour renewal window. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope. UNKNOWN while the 24-hour replacement window remains open.
gcp_certificate_renewal_30_days.fail_when: The threshold was crossed more than 24 hours ago without a timely covering ACTIVE replacement.
gcp_certificate_renewal_30_days.pass_when: The 30-day threshold has not been crossed, or a covering ACTIVE replacement was deployed by the end of the 24-hour window.

gcp_certificate_rotation_180_days.description: Compares an ACTIVE deployed Certificate Manager resource createTime with the scan timestamp. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_certificate_rotation_180_days.fail_when: An ACTIVE deployed certificate is more than 180 days old.
gcp_certificate_rotation_180_days.not_applicable_when: The certificate is undeployed or its managed state is not ACTIVE.
gcp_certificate_rotation_180_days.pass_when: An ACTIVE deployed certificate is at most 180 days old.

gcp_certificate_rotation_90_days.description: Parses leaf X.509 notBefore from pemCertificate and compares its issuance age with the scan timestamp. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_certificate_rotation_90_days.fail_when: A deployed leaf certificate was issued more than 90 days before the scan.
gcp_certificate_rotation_90_days.pass_when: A deployed leaf certificate was issued at most 90 days before the scan.

gcp_certificate_validity.description: Compares RFC3339 expireTime with snapshot created_at. For managed certificates, recognized states ACTIVE, PROVISIONING and FAILED are evaluated; non-ACTIVE or expired certificates fail. Self-managed certificates are evaluated by expiry without inventing a managed state. Conflicting certificate type unions, unrecognized states and missing or malformed status/timestamps return UNKNOWN. This does not test live certificate deployment or trust.
evaluated: expireTime; managed.state or selfManaged; snapshot created_at
gcp_certificate_validity.fail_when: Expiry is at or before snapshot time, or the recognized managed state is non-ACTIVE.
gcp_certificate_validity.pass_when: Expiry is after snapshot time and the managed state is ACTIVE, or the certificate is explicitly self-managed.

gcp_cloud_armor_cidr_deny.description: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled DENY rule with the exact reviewed expression for approved CIDRs. Missing CIDR review or verified precedence remains UNKNOWN.
evaluated: rules priority, action, disabled and match expression
gcp_cloud_armor_cidr_deny.fail_when: A complete precedence-verified policy lacks the exact approved outside-CIDR DENY rule.
gcp_cloud_armor_cidr_deny.not_applicable_when: No proven internet-facing backend attaches the policy.
gcp_cloud_armor_cidr_deny.pass_when: A complete precedence-verified policy has that enabled rule.

gcp_cloud_armor_rate_limit.description: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled matching per-client throttle or rate-based ban rule. Missing backend association, precedence, client key or match policy remains UNKNOWN.
evaluated: rules priority, action, disabled, match expression and rateLimitOptions
gcp_cloud_armor_rate_limit.fail_when: No matching enabled rule has count <=2000, intervalSec <=300 and banDurationSec >=60 on the approved client key.
gcp_cloud_armor_rate_limit.not_applicable_when: No proven internet-facing backend attaches the policy.
gcp_cloud_armor_rate_limit.pass_when: A matching enabled rule meets all three thresholds on the approved key.

gcp_cloud_armor_waf_enabled.description: A scoped, internet-facing backend attached to the policy is checked against its complete rules. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.

gcp_cloudbuild_private_pool.description: RUNNING Cloud Build worker pools are checked against an approved VPC network list. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.
gcp_cloudbuild_private_pool.fail_when: Full worker pool detail shows no peeredNetwork or a network outside the approved list.
gcp_cloudbuild_private_pool.not_applicable_when: Worker pool state is DELETED; transitional and unknown states are UNKNOWN.

gcp_cloudbuild_trigger_trust.description: On a full enabled trigger, resolves exactly one declared triggerTemplate, github or repositoryEventConfig source and compares it and serviceAccount with two explicit project-bound allowlists. triggerTemplate.projectId omission uses this project, as documented. A source or account outside its allowlist fails; both approved pass. Disabled triggers are not applicable; missing identities, conflicting selectors or incomplete facts return UNKNOWN. This does not evaluate revision regexes or actual build execution.
evaluated: Full trigger repository selector, serviceAccount and two approved allowlists
gcp_cloudbuild_trigger_trust.fail_when: The enabled trigger source or build account is outside its allowlist.
gcp_cloudbuild_trigger_trust.pass_when: The enabled trigger has one approved source and an approved build account.

gcp_cloudcdn_cache_policy.description: Checks CDN-enabled sensitive backends against a project-bound approved cache mode and maximum client/default TTL. Missing sensitivity, policy or CDN fields remain UNKNOWN.
gcp_cloudcdn_cache_policy.fail_when: A sensitive CDN-enabled backend has a cache mode outside the approved modes or either TTL exceeds its approved maximum.
gcp_cloudcdn_cache_policy.not_applicable_when: Backend is outside the sensitive list or CDN is disabled.
gcp_cloudcdn_cache_policy.pass_when: The enabled CDN policy mode and both TTLs meet the approved policy.

gcp_cloudcdn_cookie_ttl.description: For a complete Compute BackendService with GENERATED_COOKIE or HTTP_COOKIE affinity, checks the declared affinityCookieTtlSec against the signed 1800-second threshold. This field is an absolute cookie lifetime and does not prove expiry after inactivity or account for a separately configured consistentHash.httpCookie.ttl override.
gcp_cloudcdn_cookie_ttl.fail_when: An applicable cookie-affinity backend explicitly declares affinityCookieTtlSec above 1800 seconds and no greater than the provider maximum 1209600.
gcp_cloudcdn_cookie_ttl.not_applicable_when: The complete backend has a recognized sessionAffinity other than GENERATED_COOKIE or HTTP_COOKIE.
gcp_cloudcdn_cookie_ttl.pass_when: An applicable cookie-affinity backend explicitly declares affinityCookieTtlSec between 0 and 1800 seconds inclusive.

gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.description: On project resources, detects when no enabled alert policy covers FAILED Cloud SQL backup runs; this matters because it can lead to unrecoverable data loss. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: complete Logging metric and Monitoring alert inventories with verified failed-backup filter semantics
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.fail_when: No enabled alert condition references a proven failed Cloud SQL backup metric in complete coverage.
gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.pass_when: An enabled alert condition references a proven failed Cloud SQL backup metric.

gcp_cloudsql_failed_attempts_lockout.description: On sql instance resources, detects when password policy or failedAttemptsCheck is false for an in-scope SQL instance; this matters because it can lead to account takeover or privilege misuse. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_cloudsql_failed_attempts_lockout.
evaluated: new read-only SQL Admin:instances.list/get; settings.passwordValidationPolicy.enablePasswordPolicy and failedAttemptsCheck
gcp_cloudsql_failed_attempts_lockout.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope supported sql_instance.settings.passwordValidationPolicy.enablePasswordPolicy=false or failedAttemptsCheck=false; UNKNOWN when engine support or effective setting is unavailable.
gcp_cloudsql_failed_attempts_lockout.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an in-scope supported sql_instance.settings.passwordValidationPolicy.enablePasswordPolicy=false or failedAttemptsCheck=false; UNKNOWN when engine support or effective setting is unavailable.

gcp_compute_approved_image.description: Checks VM boot disk source, complete disk inventory sourceImage and approved_image_projects. The joined boot disk image project is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
evaluated: VM boot disk source, complete disk inventory sourceImage and approved_image_projects
gcp_compute_approved_image.fail_when: The joined boot disk image project is outside the approved list.
gcp_compute_approved_image.pass_when: The joined boot disk image project is approved.

gcp_compute_approved_packages.description: On instance resources, detects when an installed package is absent from approved_packages or violates approved version ranges; this matters because it can lead to unpatched exploitable software. Incomplete, malformed, stale, foreign-scope or missing required evidence stays UNKNOWN; operator policy and collection completeness are required before absence can decide a result.
evaluated: current installed package inventory and approved exact package versions or numeric dotted version ranges
complete same-project collection envelopes and exact resource identity
gcp_compute_approved_packages.fail_when: An installed package name is absent from the allowlist or its comparable version matches no approved exact version or numeric dotted range.
gcp_compute_approved_packages.not_applicable_when: The VM is outside approved VM scope.
gcp_compute_approved_packages.pass_when: Every installed package name and version matches an approved exact version or numeric dotted range.

gcp_compute_os_patch_compliance.description: On instance resources, detects when critical security packages remain unapplied beyond approved patch SLA; this matters because it can lead to unpatched exploitable software. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_compute_os_patch_compliance.
evaluated: new read-only OS Config:Inventories.get with updateTime,osInfo,items.availablePackages and vulnerabilityReport
gcp_compute_os_patch_compliance.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when an OS Config vulnerabilityReport item identifies a critical available package whose age exceeds approved_patch_sla and inventories.get updateTime is current; UNKNOWN without SLA or current inventory.
gcp_compute_os_patch_compliance.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when an OS Config vulnerabilityReport item identifies a critical available package whose age exceeds approved_patch_sla and inventories.get updateTime is current; UNKNOWN without SLA or current inventory.

gcp_gcs_replication_status.description: Requires a complete, same-project snapshot collection and valid native identities; incomplete, malformed, missing, or foreign-scope facts yield UNKNOWN. Compares declared bucket location or custom placement locations with approved locations only when an independent replicationHealth.status proves HEALTHY. Missing policy or health remains UNKNOWN.
gcp_gcs_replication_status.fail_when: Replication health is HEALTHY and declared locations differ from the approved location set.
gcp_gcs_replication_status.pass_when: Replication health is HEALTHY and declared locations equal the approved location set.

gcp_gke_client_certificate_enabled.description: Checks GKE masterAuth.clientCertificateConfig.issueClientCertificate and owner-approved exceptions. Issuance is enabled without a listed exception. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
gcp_gke_client_certificate_enabled.fail_when: Issuance is enabled without a listed exception.
gcp_gke_client_certificate_enabled.pass_when: Issuance is disabled, or enabled only under a listed exception.

gcp_gke_cluster_endpoint_publicly_access.description: Detects GKE public IP control-plane endpoint access from the Admin API endpoint configuration; the DNS endpoint and authorized-network effects are separate. Declaration-level observation only; reachability and runtime behavior require separate evidence.
evaluated: Complete unmasked GKE projects.locations.clusters.list Cluster.controlPlaneEndpointsConfig.ipEndpointsConfig.enabled and enablePublicEndpoint, with explicit full-response provenance and endpoint fields.
gcp_gke_cluster_endpoint_publicly_access.fail_when: For each collected cluster, FAIL when direct IP access is enabled and enablePublicEndpoint is explicitly true; PASS for the narrow public-IP endpoint question when direct IP access is explicitly disabled or enablePublicEndpoint is explicitly false. Proto3 omitted booleans may be interpreted as false only on a proven full unmasked response; UNKNOWN on partial/masked representation or unresolved endpoint configuration. DNS endpoint access is assessed separately.
gcp_gke_cluster_endpoint_publicly_access.pass_when: The explicit signed condition is false under complete scoped snapshot facts.

gcp_gke_small_cluster_auto_upgrade.description: Sums current targetSize for every node pool instance group and checks node auto upgrade when the total is below three. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_gke_small_cluster_auto_upgrade.fail_when: The complete target size is below three and at least one node pool disables auto upgrade.
gcp_gke_small_cluster_auto_upgrade.pass_when: The complete cluster target size is at least three, or every node pool in a smaller cluster enables auto upgrade.

gcp_https_proxy_mtls_required.description: Requires a full HTTPS proxy representation and resolves serverTlsPolicy to one same-project ServerTlsPolicy. No attached policy fails. The provider enum ALLOW_INVALID_OR_MISSING_CLIENT_CERT fails, while REJECT_INVALID passes. The invented ALLOW_INVALID value, unresolved joins, absent mode and incomplete facts return UNKNOWN. This does not validate TrustConfig contents, runtime handshakes or certificate authorization.
evaluated: Full HTTPS proxy serverTlsPolicy presence and joined ServerTlsPolicy mtlsPolicy.clientValidationMode
gcp_https_proxy_mtls_required.fail_when: The full HTTPS proxy has no attached serverTlsPolicy, or the resolved mode is ALLOW_INVALID_OR_MISSING_CLIENT_CERT.
gcp_https_proxy_mtls_required.pass_when: The uniquely resolved policy explicitly declares REJECT_INVALID.

gcp_iam_workforce_mfa.description: Checks enabled mapped workforce providers for the approved MFA claim mapping using a verified IdP assurance contract. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_iam_workforce_mfa.fail_when: An enabled mapped provider lacks that mapping.
gcp_iam_workforce_mfa.not_applicable_when: The pool is outside the approved customer mapping.
gcp_iam_workforce_mfa.pass_when: Every enabled mapped provider has the exact approved MFA assurance claim mapping.

gcp_kms_approved_algorithm.description: Compares a recognized Cloud KMS v1 algorithm on an ENABLED version with the explicit project-bound approved_algorithms list, including a deliberately empty list. Unspecified or unrecognized algorithms and malformed version identities return UNKNOWN. Recognized non-ENABLED states are not applicable. No cryptographic operation is performed.
gcp_kms_approved_algorithm.fail_when: An ENABLED version uses an algorithm outside the approved list.
gcp_kms_approved_algorithm.not_applicable_when: The version is in a recognized state other than ENABLED.
gcp_kms_approved_algorithm.pass_when: An ENABLED version uses an approved algorithm.

gcp_kms_key_destroy_alert.description: Uses complete project Logging metric and Monitoring alert-policy inventories. UNKNOWN when a required scoped inventory, approved policy/contract, source field, timestamp, or supported filter interpretation is missing, partial, malformed, or foreign to the evaluated scope.
gcp_kms_key_destroy_alert.fail_when: No such enabled metric and alert condition exist in complete inventories.
gcp_kms_key_destroy_alert.pass_when: An enabled alert condition references an enabled metric whose simple filter includes both KMS version disable and destroy methods.

gcp_kms_key_kms_keys_scheduled_deletion_.description: Checks all versions of this CryptoKey in a complete same-project CryptoKeyVersions inventory. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing version inventory, unknown state, or scheduled version without destroyTime returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_kms_key_kms_keys_scheduled_deletion_.fail_when: At least one version is DESTROY_SCHEDULED with destroyTime.
gcp_kms_key_kms_keys_scheduled_deletion_.pass_when: No listed version of the key is DESTROY_SCHEDULED with destroyTime.

gcp_lb_server_header_rewrite.description: Public URL map default and declared matcher/path/route actions are checked after complete route coverage is asserted. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.
gcp_lb_server_header_rewrite.fail_when: At least one enumerated route lacks a replace=true Server: lb response header action.
gcp_lb_server_header_rewrite.pass_when: Every enumerated route replaces Server with lb.

gcp_logging_detect_t1110.description: On audit log resources, detects when at least 10 authentication events with nonzero protoPayload.status.code have the same principalEmail and callerIp within 300 seconds; this matters because it can lead to suspicious activity that needs investigation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_logging_detect_t1110.
evaluated: new read-only Cloud Logging entries.list for the project audit log with timestamp,protoPayload.methodName,protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail,protoPayload.status.code,protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp
gcp_logging_detect_t1110.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when at least 10 authentication events with nonzero protoPayload.status.code have the same principalEmail and callerIp within 300 seconds; UNKNOWN when authentication event logging or either grouping field is unavailable.
gcp_logging_detect_t1110.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when at least 10 authentication events with nonzero protoPayload.status.code have the same principalEmail and callerIp within 300 seconds; UNKNOWN when authentication event logging or either grouping field is unavailable.

gcp_logging_detect_t1119.description: On audit log resources, detects when successful protoPayload.methodName values ending in.List or.Get for one principalEmail exceed approved_read_rate within 300 seconds; this matters because it can lead to suspicious activity that needs investigation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_logging_detect_t1119.
evaluated: new read-only Cloud Logging entries.list for the project audit log with timestamp,protoPayload.methodName,protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail,protoPayload.status.code
gcp_logging_detect_t1119.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when successful protoPayload.methodName values ending in .List or .Get for one principalEmail exceed approved_read_rate within 300 seconds; UNKNOWN without entries or the supplied rate.
gcp_logging_detect_t1119.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when successful protoPayload.methodName values ending in .List or .Get for one principalEmail exceed approved_read_rate within 300 seconds; UNKNOWN without entries or the supplied rate.

gcp_logging_detect_t1136.description: Evaluates a single observed Cloud Audit Log event for successful service-account creation by a principal outside the explicitly supplied identity-administrator allowlist; it makes no claim about events absent from the selected log window.
evaluated: project-bound Cloud Audit Log event identity, timestamp and selected log class
exact google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccount method and IAM service name

gcp_vpc_peering_allowlist.pass_when: Every ACTIVE peering target is approved.

gcp_workbench_approved_image.description: Compares one declared Workbench v2 VM or container image with the project-bound allowlist. VM identities use vm:<project>/family/<family> or vm:<project>/name/<name>; container identities use container:<repository>/<tag>. Conflicting unions, v1 imageFamily/imageName fields, digest-only container metadata, missing explicit tag, and incomplete or foreign inventories return UNKNOWN. Family approval is a declaration and does not prove an immutable image or runtime content.
gcp_workbench_approved_image.fail_when: The one valid declared image identity is outside the explicit allowlist, including an empty allowlist.
gcp_workbench_approved_image.pass_when: The one valid declared image identity is approved.

gcp_workbench_approved_vpc.description: Compares all reported Workbench interface networks with the project-bound approved network list. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing network metadata or policy returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_workbench_approved_vpc.fail_when: At least one reported network is outside the approved list.

gcp_workbench_download_disabled.description: Checks the declared download-disable metadata only for policy-classified sensitive Workbench instances. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing classification, flag, or policy returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_workbench_download_disabled.fail_when: A sensitive instance explicitly sets notebook-disable-downloads to false.
gcp_workbench_download_disabled.not_applicable_when: The project-bound policy explicitly classifies this instance as nonsensitive.
gcp_workbench_download_disabled.pass_when: A sensitive instance explicitly sets notebook-disable-downloads to true.

gcp_workbench_no_public_ip.description: Checks the declared public-IP disable flag only for policy-classified sensitive Workbench instances. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing classification, flag, or policy returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_workbench_no_public_ip.fail_when: A sensitive instance explicitly sets disablePublicIp=false.
gcp_workbench_no_public_ip.not_applicable_when: The project-bound policy explicitly classifies this instance as nonsensitive.
gcp_workbench_no_public_ip.pass_when: A sensitive instance explicitly sets disablePublicIp=true.

gcp_workbench_root_disabled.description: Checks the declared root-disable flag against sensitivity and explicit nonsensitive exception decisions. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing classification or flag returns UNKNOWN; an enabled control with missing exception policy map returns UNKNOWN; an absent per-instance exception in a complete map is unapproved.
gcp_workbench_root_disabled.fail_when: Root is enabled on a sensitive instance, or on a nonsensitive instance without an approved exception.
gcp_workbench_root_disabled.pass_when: Root is disabled, or a nonsensitive instance has an explicit approved exception to enabled root.

gcp_workbench_terminal_disabled.description: Checks the declared terminal-disable flag against sensitivity and explicit nonsensitive exception decisions. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing classification or flag returns UNKNOWN; an enabled control with missing exception policy map returns UNKNOWN; an absent per-instance exception in a complete map is unapproved.
gcp_workbench_terminal_disabled.fail_when: Terminal is enabled on a sensitive instance, or on a nonsensitive instance without an approved exception.
gcp_workbench_terminal_disabled.pass_when: Terminal is disabled, or a nonsensitive instance has an explicit approved exception to enabled terminal.

k8s.cis.a_limit_is_set_on_pod_pids.description: Checks the typed positive podPidsLimit of one operator-supplied kubelet component configuration. It does not establish per-node inventory completeness or the effective running kubelet value.
k8s.cis.a_limit_is_set_on_pod_pids.fail_when: This observed kubelet configuration record explicitly declares integer podPidsLimit zero or less.
k8s.cis.a_limit_is_set_on_pod_pids.not_applicable_when: A record for another component is NOT_APPLICABLE; missing, denied or malformed kubelet value is UNKNOWN, and cluster-wide assessment needs separately approved complete node coverage.
k8s.cis.a_limit_is_set_on_pod_pids.pass_when: This observed kubelet configuration record declares an integer podPidsLimit greater than zero.

k8s.cis.admission_allowprivilegeescalati.description: For each Namespace in a complete cluster-bound inventory, tests whether a Deny ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding covers Pod CREATE and UPDATE and binds a policy with a literal recognized CEL expression rejecting allowprivilegeescalation. A nonmatching Namespace selector or insufficient operations establishes missing coverage; arbitrary CEL, object selectors, exclusions, match conditions, parameters, Ignore failure policy and malformed or partial facts remain UNKNOWN when they might affect coverage. The result is declared admission configuration, not runtime enforcement or other policy engines.
evaluated: complete same-scope namespace and admission_policy inventories with matching provenance.cluster_id

k8s.cis.admission_allowprivilegeescalati.fail_when: At least one Namespace has no matching Deny binding in complete inventories, with no unresolved binding that could cover it.
k8s.cis.admission_allowprivilegeescalati.not_applicable_when: The complete Namespace inventory is empty.
k8s.cis.admission_allowprivilegeescalati.pass_when: Every collected Namespace has a Deny binding and matching Fail policy covering Pod CREATE and UPDATE with the recognized full-field CEL expression for allowprivilegeescalation.
