k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.description: Detects RBAC bindings with a Group subject named system:masters; this group bypasses ordinary authorization controls. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence.
k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.fail_when: A collected RBAC binding has a Group subject named system:masters.
k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.pass_when: No global PASS is emitted; the absence of observed system:masters bindings is UNKNOWN because certificate and provider group memberships are unobserved.

k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.description: Detects API servers without an enabled ImagePolicyWebhook and admission configuration; unverified images could be admitted. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using_imagepolicywebhook_admission_controller.
evaluated: Collected pod._component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins/disable-admission-plugins; proposed safe projection of admission-control-config-file from GET /api/v1/pods and operator-supplied read-only admission file metadata.
k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each kube-apiserver Pod, _component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins contains ImagePolicyWebhook, _component_config.flags.disable-admission-plugins excludes it, and _component_config.flags.admission-control-config-file is a nonempty path; UNKNOWN until the admission file content is verified.
k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each kube-apiserver Pod, _component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins contains ImagePolicyWebhook, _component_config.flags.disable-admission-plugins excludes it, and _component_config.flags.admission-control-config-file is a nonempty path; UNKNOWN until the admission file content is verified.

k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.description: Identifies Pods using CSI secret-store volumes or Kubernetes Secret references; local Secret storage can expand credential exposure. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
typed, nonempty observed Secret reference names and CSI driver; valueFrom/Secret/CSI coverage honored; only regular-container reference paths in the signed spec
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.fail_when: A Pod with a native Secret reference declares no secrets-store.csi.k8s.io CSI volume.
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.not_applicable_when: The complete PodSpec declares no native Secret reference. Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.pass_when: A Pod with a native Secret reference also declares at least one secrets-store.csi.k8s.io CSI volume.

k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.description: Detects controller-manager Pods without RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true; kubelet serving certificates may not rotate. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result. This observes the controller-manager flag only; kubelet serverTLSBootstrap, CSR approval, issued serving certificates and runtime rotation need separate evidence.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.fail_when: The unique declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=false.
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.not_applicable_when: The Pod has a complete component projection and is not kube-controller-manager. Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.pass_when: The unique explicit kube-controller-manager Pod declaration sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true.

k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected cronjob PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.daemonset_effective_runtime_defa.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected daemonset PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.daemonset_effective_runtime_defa.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.daemonset_effective_runtime_defa.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.daemonset_effective_runtime_defa.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.deployment_effective_runtime_def.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected deployment PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.deployment_effective_runtime_def.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.deployment_effective_runtime_def.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.deployment_effective_runtime_def.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.file_admin_conf_mode_600.description: Checks operator-supplied metadata for every explicitly applicable /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf path on current attested Nodes: permission bits are a subset of 0o600. This does not stat hosts or prove managed control-plane files.
evaluated: operator-attested node UID/name, selector applicability and complete exact path sets
k8s.cis.file_admin_conf_mode_600.fail_when: At least one complete observed applicable non-symlink file row violates permission bits are a subset of 0o600.
k8s.cis.file_admin_conf_mode_600.not_applicable_when: No automatic NOT_APPLICABLE outcome: an empty applicable set, inaccessible managed control plane, incomplete manifest, or unresolved path stays UNKNOWN.
k8s.cis.file_admin_conf_mode_600.pass_when: At least one applicable path is attested, every exact path row is complete, current and non-symlink, and all observed mode values meet permission bits are a subset of 0o600.

k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected job PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.description: Checks one operator-supplied kubelet configuration declaration for an explicit RotateKubeletServerCertificate feature gate. A true value is a declaration only; serverTLSBootstrap, CSR approval, issued serving certificates, runtime enforcement and all-node coverage require separate evidence.
evaluated: cluster-bound operator-supplied component_configuration with exact kubelet/node identity
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.fail_when: A supported observed kubelet declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=false.
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.not_applicable_when: The observed component is not kubelet or the reviewed version predates the gate.
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.pass_when: A supported observed kubelet declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true.

k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.description: Evaluates each collected Kubernetes namespace against a complete same-cluster NetworkPolicy inventory and an explicit cluster-bound operator declaration of system namespaces. A stored policy proves declaration presence only; CNI enforcement, default deny, Pod coverage, and reachability remain unverified.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.fail_when: A nonexempt namespace has zero NetworkPolicy objects in an authoritative complete same-cluster inventory.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.not_applicable_when: The namespace is named in the explicit cluster-bound system_namespaces operator declaration.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.pass_when: A nonexempt namespace has at least one NetworkPolicy object declared in its own namespace in a complete same-cluster inventory.

k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.description: Examines a namespace-wide NetworkPolicy declaration for egress allow rules with omitted or empty peer lists; it does not assess ports, other policies or CNI enforcement.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.fail_when: An applicable namespace-wide egress rule has an omitted or empty peer list.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.not_applicable_when: The policy does not select all Pods or does not affect egress.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.pass_when: The observed policy has an explicit empty podSelector, explicit Egress policyType, complete egress rules and no rule with omitted or empty peers.

k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.description: Examines a namespace-wide NetworkPolicy declaration for ingress allow rules with omitted or empty peer lists; it does not assess ports, other policies or CNI enforcement.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.fail_when: An applicable namespace-wide ingress rule has an omitted or empty peer list.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.not_applicable_when: The policy does not select all Pods or does not affect ingress.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.pass_when: The observed policy has an explicit empty podSelector, explicit Ingress policyType, complete ingress rules and no rule with omitted or empty peers.

k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.description: On Kubernetes versions before 1.25, joins complete PSP and RBAC inventories by effective namespace and checks that each ServiceAccount subject with Pod create authorization also has use authorization for an observed PSP. Missing joins or inventories stay UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete podsecuritypolicy, role, clusterrole, rolebinding and clusterrolebinding inventories
RBAC roleRef, subjects, rules and PSP resourceNames
k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.fail_when: A ServiceAccount subject can create Pods in a namespace but has no effective use permission for any observed PSP there.
k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.not_applicable_when: The observed Kubernetes version is 1.25 or newer.
k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.pass_when: Every ServiceAccount subject with Pod create permission in each effective namespace has use permission on at least one observed PSP.

k8s.cis.the_eventrecordqps_argument_is_s.description: Detects kubelets with eventRecordQPS below the approved capture rate; throttling can hide security events. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result. The signed predicate compares the numeric QPS value literally, including zero; it does not infer the special runtime meaning of zero.
evaluated: complete component_configuration inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
context.metadata.component_configuration_coverage has attested_complete status, matching cluster_id, positive integer node_count/max_age_seconds, and UTC observed_at fresh against context.created_at
eventRecordQPS is a nonnegative signed int32; approved_min_event_qps is a nonnegative signed int64

k8s_networkpolicy_network_policy_associa.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each networkpolicy, spec.podSelector.matchLabels or spec.podSelector.matchExpressions is nonempty; UNKNOWN on incomplete inventory.
k8s_networkpolicy_network_policy_associa.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each networkpolicy, spec.podSelector.matchLabels or spec.podSelector.matchExpressions is nonempty; UNKNOWN on incomplete inventory.

k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.description: Examines a collected NetworkPolicy ingress allow rule for an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock. An empty peer is invalid in the Kubernetes API and stays UNKNOWN pending signed proposal correction; this is not CNI or connection evidence.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.fail_when: At least one observed ingress allow rule declares all sources through an omitted/empty from list or an unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.not_applicable_when: The observed policy explicitly selects Egress but not Ingress.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.pass_when: No observed ingress rule has an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock, and no malformed peer leaves the result unresolved.

k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.description: Examines one collected NetworkPolicy ingress allow rule for all-source TCP 22 or 3389, including documented omitted source/port defaults and numeric endPort ranges. This does not prove a listener or reachability.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.fail_when: An observed ingress allow rule pairs an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted /0 ipBlock with TCP port 22 or 3389, a containing numeric endPort range, or an omitted/empty all-ports list.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.not_applicable_when: The observed policy explicitly selects Egress but not Ingress.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.pass_when: No observed ingress rule pairs an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted /0 ipBlock with TCP 22/3389 or an all-port default, and no relevant named or malformed port/peer leaves the result unresolved.

k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.description: Checks ingress rules admitting all sources against a mandatory approved protocol and port list. Missing allowlist, incomplete inventory, ambiguous IP blocks and malformed ports stay UNKNOWN.
k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.fail_when: An all-source ingress rule omits ports or declares an unapproved protocol/port.
k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.pass_when: Each all-source ingress rule has a nonempty ports list containing only approved protocol/port pairs, or no all-source rule exists.

k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.description: Classifies collected Node ExternalIP addresses for global routability; the address status does not prove inbound internet reachability.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.fail_when: An observed ExternalIP is globally routable.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.not_applicable_when: No node-level exemption; missing status is UNKNOWN.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.pass_when: No observed ExternalIP is globally routable.

k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.description: Resolves RBAC bindings and PVC verbs to detect ServiceAccounts granted PVC access across namespaces outside the approved control set. Missing role joins, namespace coverage or owner policy stays UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete role, clusterrole, rolebinding, clusterrolebinding and namespace inventories
RBAC roleRef, ServiceAccount subjects, rules apiGroups/resources/verbs
k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.fail_when: An effective binding grants a ServiceAccount a PVC verb in another namespace outside approved_control_namespaces.
k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.pass_when: No effective binding grants a ServiceAccount PVC verbs in a different, non-control namespace.

k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.description: Classifies assigned Pod IP status for global routability; this is an address signal and does not prove any route or access path.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.fail_when: An observed assigned Pod IP is globally routable.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.not_applicable_when: No Pod-level exemption; no assigned or collected IP is UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.pass_when: Every observed assigned Pod IP is not globally routable.

k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.description: Checks declared runAsUser values for regular and init containers in an explicitly Linux Pod. A missing value leaves image USER and runtime identity unknown.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.fail_when: At least one container resolves an explicit runAsUser of zero.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod; missing OS or UID is UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.pass_when: Every regular and init container resolves a positive integer runAsUser from its own or the Pod securityContext.

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.description: Detects Pods outside approved namespaces or scheduled on nodes without approved pool labels; misplaced workloads can cross isolation boundaries. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result.
evaluated: complete pod, node inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
omitted nodeSelector or labels maps mean empty only on their full native resource; observed label key/value syntax is validated
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.fail_when: The Pod namespace is outside the approved set or its bound Node has a mismatching pool label.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.not_applicable_when: Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.pass_when: The Pod namespace is approved and its unique bound Node satisfies the approved pool labels.

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.description: Detects Pods in namespaces outside the approved set; workload placement may violate isolation policy. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence. Namespace membership alone does not prove tenant isolation.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.fail_when: This Pod is in a namespace outside the explicit approved set.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.pass_when: This Pod's namespace belongs to the explicit approved set.

k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.description: Detects Pods without an imagePullSecrets reference; private registry pulls may fail or use unintended credentials. k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each pod, spec.imagePullSecrets contains at least one entry with a nonempty name; UNKNOWN if PodSpec is incomplete.
k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each pod, spec.imagePullSecrets contains at least one entry with a nonempty name; UNKNOWN if PodSpec is incomplete.

k8s_privileged_utility_access.description: Checks effective RBAC bindings for unauthorized exec and ephemeral-container grants and owner-designated privileged utility Pods for unauthorized namespaces. Missing role joins, utility identity declaration or authorization lists stay UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete role, clusterrole, rolebinding, clusterrolebinding and pod inventories
Pod namespace, name and container securityContext.privileged
k8s_privileged_utility_access.fail_when: An unauthorized subject receives pods/exec:create or pods/ephemeralcontainers:update, or a designated privileged utility Pod is outside approved namespaces.
k8s_privileged_utility_access.pass_when: No unauthorized subject receives the specified RBAC grants and each designated privileged utility Pod is in an approved namespace.

k8s_response_team_required_binding.description: Detects absence of the specified response team RBAC binding; responders may lack the permissions needed for incident action. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence. A required ServiceAccount namespace cannot be selected by the existing owner policy, so that subject kind is UNKNOWN.
evaluated: current cluster-bound required subject and role policy
k8s_response_team_required_binding.fail_when: Complete RBAC inventories lack the exact owner-required User or Group subject and role binding in every allowed namespace.
k8s_response_team_required_binding.pass_when: A valid declared User or Group subject and role binding exists in an allowed namespace; effective access is unverified.

k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.description: Uses only metadata-only Secret LIST facts to identify a server-recorded deletion request; it never reads Secret values or claims dependent workload failure.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.fail_when: A valid timezone-aware deletionTimestamp is present.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.not_applicable_when: No per-Secret exemption; missing or denied metadata is UNKNOWN.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.pass_when: The observed Secret metadata has a null or omitted deletionTimestamp.

k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.description: Detects selected LoadBalancer Services whose externalTrafficPolicy differs from the required value; traffic routing may bypass the expected source IP or node behavior. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matches_required.
evaluated: Collected service.metadata.name/namespace, spec.type, spec.externalTrafficPolicy; mandatory in_scope_service_names and required_external_traffic_policy.
k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each service whose metadata.name belongs to in_scope_service_names and spec.type="LoadBalancer", spec.externalTrafficPolicy=required_external_traffic_policy; UNKNOWN without policy inputs or complete inventory.
k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each service whose metadata.name belongs to in_scope_service_names and spec.type="LoadBalancer", spec.externalTrafficPolicy=required_external_traffic_policy; UNKNOWN without policy inputs or complete inventory.

k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.description: For a LoadBalancer Service declaration, compares its Namespace with an owner-approved namespace set. No listener reachability is inferred. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.fail_when: LoadBalancer Service is outside the owner-authorized namespace set.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.not_applicable_when: Non-LoadBalancer Services; missing policy or type is UNKNOWN.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.pass_when: LoadBalancer Service is in the owner-authorized namespace set.

k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.description: Checks whether a collected ClusterIP Service declares conventional FTP port TCP/21; it does not identify the application protocol or probe the endpoint.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.fail_when: A ClusterIP Service explicitly declares TCP port 21.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.not_applicable_when: The Service type is a recognized type other than ClusterIP.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.pass_when: A ClusterIP Service has no TCP port 21 entry.

k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.description: Compares each collected Service type to an explicitly supplied owner-required Service type. This does not prove endpoint availability. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.fail_when: Observed Service type differs from the owner-required type.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.not_applicable_when: No universal exemption; missing/conflicting policy or type is UNKNOWN.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.pass_when: Observed Service type equals the owner-required type.

k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.description: At assessed scope, compares every exact owner-selected Namespace/name/UID Service with complete Service inventory. A definite observed wrong type fails even if another selected Service is missing or recreated; otherwise unresolved identities stay UNKNOWN. External reachability is untested. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.fail_when: At least one observed selected Namespace/name/UID Service declares another supported type.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.not_applicable_when: No automatic exemption: missing or changed selected identity, incomplete Service inventory, or selected Services outside a restricted scan are UNKNOWN unless another selected Service has a definite observed wrong type.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.pass_when: Every owner-selected Service identity is observed with matching UID and LoadBalancer type across the complete assessed scope.
